**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Solutions Architect for Automotive based in India.**
 This is a high\-impact technical role focused on helping automotive organizations adopt innovative open\-source technologies and build the next generation of software\-defined vehicles.
   

  

 You will combine automotive expertise with strong Linux, embedded systems, and software development knowledge to solve complex customer challenges.
   

  

 The role spans presales consulting, technical solution design, demonstrations, proof\-of\-concepts, and selected project delivery.
   

  

 You will collaborate with specialists across cloud, Kubernetes, security, safety, and embedded technologies to develop comprehensive solutions for customers and partners.
   

  

 Your work will help shape market requirements and influence the evolution of technologies supporting connected, intelligent, and software\-defined automotive platforms.
   

  

 The position offers exposure to ambitious technology organizations and diverse engagements across the rapidly evolving automotive and open\-source ecosystem.
   

  

 This opportunity is well suited to a customer\-focused technologist who enjoys solving complex problems, learning quickly, and turning emerging technologies into practical business outcomes.
   

  

 Accountabilities
   

  

* Engage with automotive customers during presales activities to understand requirements, identify challenges, and explain relevant technologies and solutions.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor and customer advocate, helping organizations evaluate and adopt open\-source platforms for automotive use cases.
* Collaborate with specialists in cloud, Kubernetes, security, safety, embedded systems, and other technical domains to develop comprehensive customer solutions.
* Participate in selected Embedded Linux projects, including technical demonstrations, prototypes, and proof\-of\-concepts.
* Translate customer and market requirements into actionable insights for internal engineering, product, and business stakeholders.
* Contribute to the development and refinement of reusable technical solutions that address emerging automotive market opportunities.
* Support initiatives related to software\-defined vehicles and the application of cloud technologies to embedded automotive environments.
* Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and business audiences through presentations, demonstrations, and customer discussions.
* Balance multiple customer engagements and priorities while maintaining a strong focus on delivery, quality, and business outcomes.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Relevant professional experience within the automotive industry.
* Extensive Linux experience, with strong knowledge of Debian or Ubuntu preferred.
* Solid Embedded Linux experience, including exposure to Yocto and/or real\-time operating systems.

12107b56.title: AI Architect
12107b56.description:
Accellor is looking for an AI Architect to build and strengthen its AI, Data and Engineering solutions in the organization.


This is a strategic leadership role responsible for building a high\-performing AI \& Data Center of Excellence, driving AI\-led innovation, strengthening enterprise delivery capabilities, developing strategic client relationships, and building a world\-class technology organization.


The ideal candidate will be a proven AI/Technology lead, AI Practice lead, Engineering lead or Data \& AI Leader — with strong experience in Generative AI, Agentic AI, Data and enterprise technology, combined with exceptional people, client and business leadership skills.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* AI \& Technology Leadership: Work with leadership to drive execution of the AI \& Data strategy aligned with Accellor's global AI vision and roadmap.
* Practice Building: Build and scale a high\-performing AI, Data and Engineering organization.
* Generative \& Agentic AI: Lead adoption and delivery of GenAI, LLM, RAG, AI Agents, Machine Learning and intelligent automation solutions.
* Product \& Innovation: Drive development of AI products, platforms, accelerators, reusable frameworks and intellectual property.
* Client Leadership: Engage with CXOs and enterprise clients to identify AI opportunities, shape technology strategies and drive business outcomes.
* Delivery Excellence: Ensure strategic AI programs are delivered with high quality, speed, scalability and measurable ROI.
* Business Growth: Partner with Sales and Business Development on AI\-led opportunities, pre\-sales, solutioning, proposals and account expansion.
* People Leadership: Attract, develop and retain top AI/ML, Data Engineering, Software Engineering and Architecture talent.
* Thought Leadership: Represent Accellor externally through AI/technology forums, industry events, partnerships and thought leadership initiatives.

  

**Requirements**  

* 15–18 years of experience in Technology, AI, Data, Product Engineering or Consulting, including 8\+ years leading an AI team in a senior leadership capacity.
* Proven experience as an AI Architect, Technology Lead, Engineering Lead, Data \& AI Leader or equivalent in Consulting and Service Industry.
* Strong expertise in Generative AI, LLMs, Agentic AI, RAG, Machine Learning, Data Engineering and Cloud platforms.
* Proven track record of taking AI initiatives from PoC Production Scale.
* Experience building and leading large, high\-performing technology organizations.
* Strong enterprise client\-facing and C\-suite stakeholder management experience.
* Demonstrated understanding of business growth, revenue, margins, delivery and commercial outcomes.
* Exceptional communication, strategic thinking and executive leadership capabilities.
* Engineering/technology degree from a well\-recognized institution; an advanced degree (M.Tech/MS/MBA) from a premier institute is a plus.

 **Preferred Background:**

* Experience in SaaS, IT Services, Enterprise Technology, E\-commerce, Martech, Digital Products or AI\-first organizations is preferred.
* Prior experience in building or scaling a technology/AI Center of Excellence will be an advantage.

 **What Success Looks Like:**

* Co\-lead the organization as a strategic AI \& Data Center of Excellence.
* Build and scale a strong AI/Data/Engineering team in the organization.
* Drive significant AI\-led enterprise client opportunities.
* Launch multiple AI products, accelerators or client solutions into production.
* Strengthen talent acquisition, retention and AI capability development.

 **Benefits** **Exciting Projects:** We focus on industries like High\-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.

**Collaborative Environment:** You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centres.  

**Work\-Life Balance:** Accellor prioritizes work\-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.  

**Professional Development:** Our dedicated Learning \& Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training, Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.  

  

**Excellent Benefits:** We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Personal Accident Insurance, Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.

**Disclaimer: \-**


Accellor is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic

104f3b50.description:
About Letitbex AI:
Letitbex AI is a fast\-growing AI\-driven technology company focused on building intelligent, scalable, and enterprise\-grade solutions. We work at the intersection of AI, data engineering, cloud, and business transformation, helping organizations unlock real value from artificial intelligence.  

Position: Salesforce Architect
Experience: 12\+ Years
Notice Period: Can be considered up 15 Days  

  

**Job Description:**
We are seeking a **Senior Salesforce Developer** with deep expertise in **Apex** and **Object\-Oriented Programming** to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of **6 years of experience** in Salesforce development, with a strong background in designing and implementing scalable backend solutions. Prior experience in **Salesforce CPQ** is preferred.
As a Senior Salesforce Developer, you will be primarily responsible for developing the **backend core logic for a custom CPQ solution using Apex**. You will work closely with architects, business analysts, and front\-end developers to ensure seamless integration and high\-performance solutions.**Key Responsibilities:*** Design, develop, and implement backend logic for a **custom CPQ solution** using **Apex**.
* Write efficient, scalable, and maintainable code while adhering to best practices and coding standards.
* Develop and maintain complex **triggers, batch jobs, future methods, and queueable Apex classes**.
* Optimize **SOQL and SOSL** queries for performance and scalability.
* Work on **Salesforce integrations**, including REST/SOAP APIs, external services, and middleware.
* Collaborate with **Salesforce Architects and Administrators** to design technical solutions that align with business requirements.
* Troubleshoot and resolve performance issues, security vulnerabilities, and data inconsistencies.
* Participate in code reviews, provide mentorship to junior developers, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
* Stay updated with Salesforce releases, new features, and best practices to ensure optimal solution design.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications:*** **6\+ years of experience** in Salesforce development.
* **Deep expertise in Apex programming** and **Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP)** concepts.
* Hands\-on experience with **Salesforce CPQ** (preferred but not mandatory).
* Strong understanding of **Salesforce data model, governor limits, and security model**.
* Experience with **SOQL, SOSL, and database optimization**.
* Knowledge of **Lightning Web Components (LWC)** and front\-end development (preferred but not required).
* Experience with **Salesforce APIs (REST, SOAP, Bulk, Streaming)**.
* Familiarity with **CI/CD tools, Git, and version control**.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.
* Salesforce **Platform Developer I (PD1\) Certification** is mandatory.

**Preferred Qualifications:*** Experience working in an **Agile development environment**.
* Knowledge of **Salesforce Flow, Process Builder, and declarative tools**.
* Additional Salesforce certifications such as **Platform Developer II (PD2\)** or **CPQ Specialist** are a plus.

fa3ff360.description:
Company: Infodat India Pvt. Ltd. Location: Hyderabad (on\-site) — with travel to client sites in West Africa Department: Engineering / Solutions Experience: 10–15 years Employment type: Full\-time Availability: Immediate joiners preferred
 



 About the role
 



 Infodat India is looking for a Solution Architect to lead the design and delivery of enterprise solutions for our oil \& gas downstream clients, including engagements in West Africa. You'll translate complex business requirements into robust, scalable technical architectures, guide delivery teams through implementation, and act as the senior technical authority in front of clients.
 



 This is a client\-facing, delivery\-oriented architecture role. You'll be expected to travel to West Africa for discovery, solution workshops, deployment, and go\-live support, so willingness and ability to travel to the region is essential.
 



 What you'll do
 



 · Own end\-to\-end solution architecture — application, data, integration, and infrastructure — for downstream oil \& gas engagements (retail fuel management, terminal/depot automation, distribution and logistics, forecourt/POS, supply and marketing systems).
 



 · Engage clients directly to elicit requirements, run solution workshops, and present architecture and trade\-offs to both technical and business stakeholders.
 



 · Define technical roadmaps, integration patterns, and non\-functional requirements (performance, security, scalability, availability).
 



 · Guide and review the work of development and implementation teams; ensure the build stays true to the architecture.
 



 · Lead deployment, go\-live, and stabilization at client sites in West Africa, including hands\-on troubleshooting.
 



 · Drive process rigor and measurable quality into delivery using Six Sigma / Lean principles.
 



 · Support pre\-sales and proposals with solution designs, effort estimates, and technical presentations.
 



 · Manage architectural risk and make pragmatic build\-vs\-buy and technology\-selection decisions.
 



 What we're looking for
 



 · 10–15 years in software/solution delivery, with several years in a solution or enterprise architect capacity.
 



 · Proven experience with oil \& gas downstream applications — refining, distribution, retail/marketing, terminal automation, or related systems.
 



 · Strong architecture credentials across application, data, and integration layers; experience with enterprise integration (APIs, middleware, messaging).
 



 · Demonstrated ability to lead client\-facing engagements and own solutions end to end.
 



 · Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or above) with hands\-on application to delivery quality and process improvement.
 



 · Willingness and ability to travel to West Africa for extended client engagements.
 



 · Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
 



 · Immediate availability or a short notice period.
 



 Nice to have
 



 · Prior on\-site delivery experience in West Africa or emerging markets.
 



 · Exposure to SCADA/terminal automation, fuel retail POS, or supply\-chain/logistics platforms.
 



 · Cloud architecture experience (Azure/AWS) and modernization of legacy systems.
 



 · Relevant architecture certifications (TOGAF, cloud architect certifications).

As an increasing number of enterprises move their critical systems to the cloud, AWS India is in need of highly efficient technical consulting talent to help our largest and strategically important customers navigate the operational challenges and complexities of AWS Cloud. We are looking for Technical Consultants to support our customers creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Data Analytics, Application services, Networking, Server\-less and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor for organizations ranging from start\-ups to large enterprises.  

  

As a Senior Technical Account Manager, you will be the primary technical point of contact for one or more customers helping to plan, debug, and oversee ongoing operations of business\-critical applications. You will get your hands dirty, troubleshooting application, network, database, and architectural challenges using a suite of internal AWS Cloud tools as well as your existing knowledge and toolkits. We are seeking individuals with strong backgrounds in I.T. Consulting and in any of these related areas such as Solution Designing, Application and System Development, Database Management, Big Data and Analytics, DevOps Consulting, and Media technologies. Knowledge of programming and scripting is beneficial to the role.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Every day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:  

  

* You’ll build solutions, provide technical guidance and advocate for the customer
* Ensure AWS environments remain operationally healthy whilst reducing cost and complexity
* Develop trusting relationships with customers, understanding their business needs and technical challenges
* Using your technical acumen and customer obsession, you’ll drive technical discussions regarding incidents, trade\-offs, and risk management
* Consult with a range of partners from developers through to C\-suite executives
* Collaborate with AWS Solutions Architects, Business Developers, Professional Services Consultants, and Sales Account Managers
* With a bias for action, you'll proactively find opportunities for customers to gain additional value from AWS
* Provide detailed reviews of service disruptions, metrics, detailed pre\-launch planning
* Solve a variety of problems across different customers as they migrate their workloads to the cloud
* Uplift customer capabilities by running workshops, brown bag sessions, etc.

  

Watch a short video about life as a Technical Account Manager here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=J\_Rm0QgWvQ8  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  

  

A day in the life  

As a Senior TAM, you will help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers’ adoption and use of AWS services \- including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, Bedrock, SageMaker, and many more. Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support, and risk management.  

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS.  

  

About the team  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7\+ years of hands\-on infrastructure, troubleshooting, systems administration, networking, DevOps or applications development experience
* Knowledge of of cloud based architecture, cloud services and experience in customer facing roles
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, math, or equivalent, or experience in a STEM field equivalent to a four year degree
* Experience in external enterprise customer\-facing role as a technical lead, with strong oral and written communication skills, presenting to both large and small audiences
* Experience in a 24x7 operational services or support environment

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer\-facing environment as a technical lead
* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in one or more of the following areas: software design or development, content distribution/CDN, scripting/automation, database architecture, IP networking, IT security, BigData/Hadoop/Spark, operations management, service oriented architecture

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

7c0b74f8.title: Senior ServiceNow Solutions Architect
7c0b74f8.description:
**Company Overview**
 Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee\-first, performance\-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category\-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
   

  

 Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short\-term and long\-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people\-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry\-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 Job Description
   

  

**ServiceNow Solution Architect** 
 leads implementation projects for our clients. This consulting role acts as a trusted advisor and technical leader, guiding organizations through the design, configuration, and deployment of ServiceNow solutions. Translates business needs into scalable architectures, ensures alignment with best practices, and oversees the delivery of end\-to\-end ServiceNow implementations across ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HR, and other enterprise workflows.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Lead ServiceNow Implementations**
 Oversees the full lifecycle of ServiceNow projects, from discovery and requirements gathering to design, build, testing, deployment, and post\-implementation support.
   

  

**Solution Architecture**
 Define sand document scalable ServiceNow architectures, ensuring alignment with client requirements, industry best practices, and ServiceNow’s platform capabilities.
   

  

**Client Advisory**
 Acts as the primary technical consultant to clients, advising on platform strategy, governance, integration approaches, and roadmap planning.
   

  

**Team Leadership**
 Provides technical leadership to project teams, including developers, business analysts, and administrators, ensuring consistent delivery quality.
   

  

**Stakeholder Engagement**
 Collaborates with business leaders, IT executives, and cross\-functional teams to translate business goals into technical solutions.
   

  

**Quality \& Compliance**
 Establishes architectural standards, design patterns, and guardrails to ensure secure, maintainable, and future\-ready implementations.
   

  

**Innovation**
 Stays current with ServiceNow releases, new features, and emerging capabilities to provide thought leadership and innovative solutions for clients.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Experience:
   

  

 10 years of experience across the platform. 6\+ years
 **ServiceNow solution design and delivery** 
 . Proven experience leading multiple enterprise level ServiceNow implementations.
   

  

**Technical Expertise**
* 
+ Strong knowledge of ServiceNow architecture, including CSDM (Common Service Data Model), Flow Designer, Integrations (REST/SOAP), and Service Portal.
+ Experience with IT workflows (Incident, Problem, Change, Request, CMDB, Discovery, Asset, HRSD, etc.).


**Certifications**
 ServiceNow certifications required.
   

  

* 
+ CSA
+ CAD
+ CIS Data Foundations


 Must have a combination of multiple CIS
   

  

* 
+ ISTM (required)
+ ITOM (Discovery, Service Mapping, Event ma
+ HAM
+ SAM
+ HRSD


**Preferred Certifications**
* 
+ ServiceNow Certified technical Architect (CTA)


**Consulting Skills**
* 
+ Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage senior stakeholders.
+ Strong problem\-solving, facilitation, and client management capabilities.
+ Ability to lead workshops, drive consensus, and deliver clear architectural documentation.


**Compensation**
 Estimated Pay Range:
   

  

 Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.
   

  

****Our Commitment to Diversity \& Inclusion****
 At Milestone we strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and work with, where we all feel empowered to bring our full, authentic selves to work. We know creating a diverse and inclusive culture that champions equity and belonging is not only the right thing to do for our employees but is also critical to our continued success.
   

  

 Milestone Technologies provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law, or local ordinance. Milestone also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled applicants and employees.
   

  

 We welcome the unique background, culture, experiences, knowledge, innovation, self\-expression and perspectives you can bring to our global community. Our recruitment team is looking forward to meeting you.
   

  

  

  

  

**\*\*\*Notice to Job Seekers Regarding Impersonation and Fraudulent Job Offers\*\*\***
 It has come to our attention that unauthorized individuals and entities are impersonating Milestone Technologies, Inc. on various job boards/portals,
 **specifically Naukri.com and Linkedin.com**
**Please be advised of the following official Milestone Technologies recruitment policies:**
**Official Communication Channels**
 All legitimate email communications from our recruitment team will originate ONLY from the domains:
 **@milestone.tech.** 
 We do not use generic email services (e.g. @gmail.com, @yahoo.com, @outlook.com) or unofficial third party messaging apps to conduct formal business.
   

  

**No Recruitment Fees**
 Milestone Technologies never requests any form of payment, "security deposit", "laptop/equipment fee", or "processing fee" at any stage of the recruitment or onboarding process. Any request for money in exchange for an interview or job offer is a scam.

9aa5d875.title: Cloud Support Engineer
9aa5d875.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Cloud Support Engineer based in India.**
 This role offers the opportunity to support customers operating critical workloads across Linux, cloud, and open source environments.
   

  

 You will act as a trusted technical advisor, helping engineering teams troubleshoot complex infrastructure and application issues.
   

  

 The position combines hands\-on technical problem solving with strong customer communication and relationship management.
   

  

 You will investigate incidents, analyze logs and stack traces, identify root causes, and collaborate with engineering teams on effective resolutions.
   

  

 You will also contribute to the broader technical community by documenting solutions and sharing knowledge through accessible technical resources.
   

  

 The role suits a curious and empathetic engineer who enjoys solving challenging problems while helping customers succeed with open source technologies.
   

  

 You will work in a highly distributed environment with global collaboration and opportunities for continuous learning and professional growth.
   

  

 Accountabilities
   

  

* Engage directly with customers through support cases, remote sessions, and live conversations to understand technical challenges and provide effective solutions.
* Troubleshoot complex Linux, cloud, networking, storage, virtualization, and container\-related issues across customer environments.
* Analyze logs, stack traces, system behavior, and application issues to identify potential operating system or application\-level bugs and determine appropriate next steps.
* Take ownership of assigned support cases, maintain clear communication, manage expectations, and ensure commitments are delivered consistently.
* Collaborate closely with internal engineering teams and regional technical peers to investigate difficult problems and coordinate fixes.
* Develop a strong understanding of the Ubuntu development and release lifecycle to provide customers with accurate context around engineering fixes and timelines.
* Create and maintain clear knowledge base articles that capture troubleshooting approaches, solutions, and lessons learned for the wider technical community.
* Participate in a regular weekend support rotation to provide reliable coverage for customers across global time zones.


**Requirements**
* Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly, professionally, and empathetically.
* Strong customer\-service orientation, emotional intelligence, and composure when handling high\-impact or technically challenging situations.
* An undergraduate degree in a technical discipline, or a compelling alternative professional or educational background demonstrating equivalent capability.
* A strong academic record and a demonstrated history of delivering high\-quality results beyond standard expectations.
* Hands\-on experience supporting Linux systems in professional or technical environments.
* Practical exposure to at least three areas including KVM or OpenStack, Docker, LXD/LXC or Kubernetes, block/object/network storage, and system networking concepts such as bonding, firewalls, bridging, switching, or MTU configuration.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities, including the capacity to investigate logs and stack traces, isolate technical issues, and guide customers through resolution steps.
* Basic programming knowledge in at least one language, with sufficient understanding of programming logic to interpret code and collaborate effectively with software engineering teams.
* A genuine interest in open source technologies and a willingness to continuously develop technical expertise across Linux and cloud infrastructure.


**Benefits**
* Competitive compensation based on geographical location, experience, and performance.
* Performance\-driven annual bonus or commission opportunities.
* Annual compensation reviews designed to recognize strong performance.
* Fully distributed work environment with opportunities to meet colleagues in person during regular team events.
* Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
* Recognition and performance rewards.
* Annual holiday leave.
* Maternity and paternity leave.
* Employee Assistance Programme.
* Opportunities to travel internationally and collaborate with colleagues in new locations.
* Priority Pass access and travel upgrades for eligible long\-haul company events.


**How Jobgether Works**
 We use an
 **AI\-powered matching process** 
 to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top\-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
   

  

 We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!
   

  

 Why Apply Through Jobgether?
   

  

**Data Privacy Notice:** 
 By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre\-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

b2491c14.title: Technical Program Manager – Infrastructure Engineering
b2491c14.description:
**Role Description**
**Client Job Title: Technical Program Manager – Infrastructure Engineering**
**Who We Are**
 At UST, we help the world’s best organizations grow and succeed through transformation. Bringing together the right talent, tools, and ideas, we work with our client to co\-create lasting change. Together, with over 30,000 employees in over 25 countries, we build for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process. Visit us at UST.com.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As an Infra Engineering TPM you will be the connective tissue between SRE, Platform Developers, Architects, and the broader engineering organization. You will own planning, execution, and communication for infrastructure programs—ensuring work aligns to product priorities and is delivered on time with high quality. You’ll support the Head of Infrastructure to turn strategic priorities into actionable roadmaps and to unblock teams operating in a fast\-moving start\-up environment.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Program leadership**
* Lead end\-to\-end technical programs across infrastructure domains (GPU orchestration, cluster management, networking, storage, telemetry, provisioning pipelines).
* Align program scope, milestones, dependencies, success metrics, and delivery timelines.
* Drive program rituals: kickoff, sprint alignment, risk reviews, and postmortems.
* Cross\-team coordination \& stakeholder management
* Proactively support the Head of Infrastructure in setting priorities, sequencing work, meeting coordination, and driving execution across teams.
* Serve as the coordinator within infrastructure organization: SRE, Platform Developers, Architects.
* Proactively surface and manage dependencies, blockers, and risks across teams.
* Communicate program status, trade\-offs, and timelines to the Head of Infrastructure and other stakeholders.


**Delivery and process**
* Manage roadmaps and release plans for multi\-team infrastructure initiatives; work directly with the Head of Infrastructure to align execution with strategic goals and adjust priorities as needed.
* Implement scalable program management practices (OKRs, milestones, RACI, risk logs, SLAs).
* Ensure engineering deliverables meet performance, reliability, security, and cost targets.


**Technical grounding \& decision support**
* Maintain a strong technical understanding of GPU infrastructure, ensure architecture and program decisions align with NVIDIA NCP (NVIDIA Cloud Platform) reference architecture and best practices where applicable — including hardware configurations, networking/topology, telemetry, and security recommendations.
* Facilitate architecture reviews and help translate architecture into executable work for platform engineers and SREs.


**Reliability \& operations enablement**
* Coordinate SRE\-driven reliability initiatives (SLOs, incident response playbooks, SOP).
* Help prioritize reliability work vs. feature work and plan operational runbooks, testing, and rollout strategies.


**Metrics \& continuous improvement**
* Define and track key KPIs (uptime, mean time to recovery, provisioning latency).
* Use data to drive prioritization and continuous improvement cycles.


**Requirements Minimum**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 5\+ years of technical program management experience at an infrastructure\- or platform\-oriented organization (start\-up experience strongly preferred).
* Strong technical background with hands\-on familiarity in at least one of: GPU compute stacks, Kubernetes, cluster orchestration, or cloud infrastructure.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating across SRE, platform engineering, and architecture teams to deliver complex multi\-quarter programs.
* Proven track record of delivering projects with multiple engineering teams and external dependencies.
* Excellent written and verbal communication—able to summarize technical trade\-offs and program status for executive stakeholders.
* Strong organizational skills: roadmaps, dependency mapping, risk management, and prioritization.

**Experience:**

**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for an experienced Cybersecurity Presales Consultant with 10–12 years of expertise in designing, positioning, and presenting enterprise cybersecurity solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on and consultative experience across Privileged Access Management (PAM), Identity and Access Management (IAM), Endpoint Privilege Management (EPM), and Security Configuration Management (SCM). This role requires close collaboration with sales, delivery, product, and customer teams to translate business and security requirements into scalable, compliant, and commercially viable security solutions.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead end\-to\-end cybersecurity presales engagements, including requirement gathering, discovery workshops, solution design, technical presentations, product demonstrations, proof of concepts, and proposal support.
* Design and position solutions across PAM, IAM, EPM, and SCM aligned to customer security posture, compliance requirements, and business objectives.
* Prepare high\-quality technical proposals, solution architecture documents, bill of materials, statements of work, RFP/RFI responses, compliance matrices, and commercial inputs.
* Engage with CISOs, CIOs, IT heads, risk teams, compliance teams, and infrastructure stakeholders to understand pain points and map them to relevant cybersecurity solutions.
* Collaborate with sales teams to build account strategy, qualify opportunities, influence deal progression, and support revenue growth.
* Work closely with OEMs and technology partners for solution validation, pricing, licensing, sizing, and competitive positioning.
* Conduct customer workshops and deep\-dive sessions on privileged access, identity governance, least privilege, endpoint privilege control, secure configuration, and Zero Trust principles.
* Support smooth handover from presales to delivery teams, ensuring scope, assumptions, dependencies, and success criteria are clearly documented.
* Stay updated on cybersecurity trends, regulatory requirements, threat landscape, and emerging technologies relevant to identity, privilege, endpoint, and configuration security.



  





**Required Skills and Experience** 



* 10–12 years of overall experience in cybersecurity, information security, solution consulting, presales, or technical architecture roles.
* Strong understanding of PAM concepts including privileged account discovery, credential vaulting, session management, password rotation, just\-in\-time access, break\-glass access, and least privilege models.
* Experience with PAM platforms such as CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Delinea/Thycotic, Arcon or similar solutions.
* Good knowledge of IAM concepts such as identity lifecycle management, access governance, single sign\-on, multi\-factor authentication, role\-based access control, federation, SAML, OAuth, LDAP, and Active Directory integration.
* Experience in Endpoint Privilege Management, including application control, privilege elevation, local admin rights management, endpoint hardening, and policy\-based access control.
* Understanding of Security Configuration Management, secure baseline configuration, compliance checks, vulnerability remediation support, policy enforcement, and configuration drift management.
* Ability to map customer requirements to cybersecurity frameworks and standards such as ISO 27001, NIST, CIS Controls, RBI guidelines, CERT\-In directions, GDPR, and other applicable compliance requirements.
* Strong documentation, presentation, stakeholder management, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to independently manage complex enterprise opportunities and influence technical as well as business decision makers.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related field.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CEH, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Lead Auditor, CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Delinea, Microsoft Security, or other IAM/PAM certifications will be an advantage.



  





**Key Competencies** 



* Consultative selling and solution\-oriented mindset.
* Strong customer\-facing communication and executive presentation skills.
* Ability to simplify complex cybersecurity concepts for technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong ownership, collaboration, and problem\-solving abilities.

This is **not purely a development role**.

You will work directly with customers to understand their programmes and operational problems, translate them into technology solutions, architect solutions across the Zoho ecosystem, and take ownership of projects through successful delivery.

We expect you to maintain a strong **customer pulse**: understanding not only what has been requested, but whether the solution is actually working for the people using it.

**What you will do1\. Understand problems before building solutions**

You will work directly with customers, particularly nonprofits and social\-impact organisations, to understand their programmes, workflows and challenges.

You will:

* Conduct requirement and discovery conversations with customers
* Understand the underlying problem rather than simply documenting requested features
* Map programme and business processes into technology workflows
* Ask the right questions when requirements are incomplete or ambiguous
* Convert discussions into clear requirements, workflows and solution designs
* Recommend simpler or better approaches when appropriate

**2\. Architect and build Zoho solutions**

You will design solutions across the Zoho ecosystem based on the customer's actual requirements.

Depending on the project, this may involve:

* Zoho Creator
* Zoho CRM
* Zoho Analytics
* Zoho Books
* Zoho Desk
* Zoho People
* Zoho Projects
* Zoho Flow
* Other Zoho applications and third\-party systems

You should be comfortable with:

* Deluge
* APIs and integrations
* Data modelling
* Workflow automation
* Roles and permissions
* Reports and dashboards
* System architecture and solution design

You should be technically strong enough to build important components yourself while also being able to guide other engineers.

**3\. Own delivery, not just development**

We are looking for someone who can take responsibility for an outcome rather than only completing assigned tickets.

You will:

* Own projects or significant workstreams from discovery through go\-live
* Break solutions into clear deliverables for developers and QA
* Estimate effort and help plan implementations
* Review progress, quality and risks
* Coordinate UAT and customer feedback
* Ensure issues move towards closure rather than remaining indefinitely open
* Identify dependencies and escalations early
* Maintain clear documentation and communication

**4\. Be a trusted customer\-facing consultant**

A significant part of this role involves working directly with customers.

You should be comfortable speaking with programme managers, operations teams, M\&E teams, technology teams and organisational leadership.

We expect you to develop a strong understanding of the customer's context and proactively identify when something is not working.

Good consulting, for us, means being able to say:

**"I understand what you're asking us to build, but I think there may be a better way to solve the underlying problem."**

**What we are looking forMust have**

* Strong hands\-on experience with the Zoho ecosystem, particularly Zoho Creator and/or Zoho CRM
* Strong understanding of Deluge, workflows, APIs and integrations
* Approximately 3–6 years of relevant technology experience
* Experience translating business requirements into technology solutions
* Experience interacting directly with customers or business stakeholders
* Ability to independently structure ambiguous requirements
* Strong written and verbal communication
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities
* Experience owning delivery rather than only executing development tasks
* Experience or meaningful exposure to **education, skilling, livelihoods, healthcare, development sector or other social\-impact domains**
* Genuine interest in using technology to strengthen nonprofits and mission\-driven organisations
* Willingness to work from or relocate to **Coimbatore**, with a hybrid working structure possible

**Good to have**

* Experience working with a Zoho Partner or Zoho consulting organisation
* Experience progressing from Zoho Developer/Engineer towards Consultant, Technical Lead or Solution Architect responsibilities
* Experience designing solutions spanning multiple Zoho applications
* Experience leading or mentoring developers
* Zoho certifications
* Experience conducting discovery workshops or solution demonstrations
* Experience with programme MIS, M\&E systems, case management or field\-data systems
* Pre\-sales, estimation or proposal experience

**Working in an AI\-native environment**

We believe AI is changing how software is designed, developed and delivered.

We increasingly experiment with AI across requirement analysis, solution design, coding, testing, documentation and internal productivity.

You **do not need to be an AI engineer**.

However, we would love to meet people who are already experimenting with tools such as **Claude or other AI coding and productivity tools**, and are excited about figuring out how AI can make them dramatically better at their work.

More important than knowing a particular AI tool is the curiosity to keep learning as the technology changes.

**The mindset we value**

Technical capability is important, but how you approach problems matters just as much.

**High agency and ownership** You don't wait for every problem to be converted into a task. When something isn't working, your instinct is to understand why and figure out what can be done.

**Curiosity** You enjoy learning. A new Zoho capability, an unfamiliar nonprofit programme, a new AI tool or an integration you haven't encountered before is something you want to explore.

**Empathy** You listen carefully to customers and end users. You try to understand the reality behind a requirement rather than treating it simply as another feature request.

**Growth mindset** You actively seek feedback, learn from mistakes and continuously expand what you are capable of doing.

**Pursuit of excellence** You don't consider something complete simply because it works. You question assumptions, critique your own work and care about whether the solution is genuinely well designed.

**Bias for action** You can operate when everything isn't perfectly defined. You gather the information you need, make sensible decisions and move things forward.

**Low ego and collaboration** You are willing to ask for help, challenge ideas respectfully, change your mind when someone has a better solution and step beyond your formal responsibilities when needed.

**Commitment to impact** You care about what happens after the software is deployed. You want technology to make organisations and the people they serve more effective.

**Who will thrive in this role?**

You will probably enjoy this role if you have reached a point in your engineering career where you are asking more questions about **why something should be built**, rather than only **how to build it**.

You enjoy the technical side of your work, but you also enjoy sitting with a customer, understanding a messy real\-world problem and turning it into something structured.

You want to become the person who can move between:

**Problem → Process → Solution → Architecture → Delivery → Customer outcome.**

And you are looking for an environment where the boundaries of your role can expand as your capabilities grow.

If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹800,000\.00 \- ₹1,000,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Food provided

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu 641042

c4d8e99a.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience analyzing data and generating business insights.
* 7 years of experience developing operational process solutions, and working with cross\-functional teams to drive these changes.
* 7 years of experience in a customer or client\-facing role.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Demonstrated expertise in spreadsheet\-based financial modeling, resource planning, and building multi\-variable operational scenarios.
* Experience collaborating with and presenting to technical stakeholders (Product Managers, Engineers, and Executive leaders), including the ability to influence roadmap decisions and hold technical teams accountable to business outcomes.
* Familiarity with managing large\-scale global vendor operations, outsourced partner networks, or shared services environments.
* Proven ability to analyze complex operational metrics (e.g., Customer Handling Time, deflection, reopen rates, accuracy) to extract actionable insights.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.
  

  

As a Service Delivery Manager, you will sit at the intersection of operational delivery, AI\-first technology integration, and financial governance. In this role, you will lead the end\-to\-end operational strategy, budget planning, and tool\-readiness evaluations across a global partner network.  

  

You will be responsible for driving the transition of complex user journeys toward automated and agentic models, overseeing specialized quality and pre\-release testing operations, and conducting deep quantitative analysis to measure process efficiency.  

  

This role requires a proactive leader who can translate operational trends into technical inputs, manage an Operating Expenses (OpEx) budget, and partner closely with Product and Engineering teams to hold technical solutions accountable to real\-world performance metrics.  

  

Our core operations primarily follow standard business hours. However, ensuring a seamless customer experience across our global markets is central to our strategy. To solve for critical customer needs and to optimize resolution velocity, you may occasionally be aligned to alternative shifts schedules on a rotational basis. To fully support your well\-being, Google provides support for any non\-standard operational shifts.Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Drive the end\-to\-end operational strategy for Google's customer support models, with a specific focus on scaling automated and agentic solutions for designated user segments.
* Manage, track, and execute an annual operational expenditure budget. Design resource allocation models, evaluate multi\-variable operational scenarios, and manage partner staffing ramps or transfers in line with budget guidelines.
* Oversee minimum quality bar frameworks and dedicated partner teams focused on pre\-release testing, UAT, logic stress testing, and model tuning. Ensure all systems adhere to Google's core customer experience quality and safety standards.
* Design and execute quantitative studies to calculate and show the case of managing time savings of future tool and feature rollouts. Partner with Data Science and product teams to standardize measurement assumptions.
* Act as the liaison between scaled operations and technical teams.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

* Experience with backend languages (e.g. Java, Python, or C\+\+).

Technology and Insights Support Systems domain delivers technology to YouTube Support, optimizing the systems that empower our global support communities, ensuring seamless, delightful experiences for millions of users to increase the loyalty of our users.


As a Web Solutions Engineer on the YouTube Business Technology team, you will be responsible for managing solutions that make the broader YouTube organization more efficient. Your efforts will launch quickly and have an immediate impact on those around you.


You will be working as a part of an engineering team responsible for developing and supporting tools, prototyping proofs\-of\-concept, and writing/reviewing technical design documents to meet the needs of our services teams. You will adhere to Google’s software development best practices and work in close partnership with other project/product management and engineering teams.

Currently engineers will adjust the projects they are working on based on the need but are primarily focused on a full stack development including (listed in terms of headcount allocated):

* Web Application
* Backend Services
* Data Pipeline
* AI/ML \- use of LLM or model fine\-tuning


At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting\-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

This may include ensuring reliable backends, building pipelines to aggregate data from multiple sources, implementing responsive and UX\-rich frontends, or enhancing performance of existing tools and services.

415a4e47.title: Senior Solutions Architect, Automotive and Manufacturing, AWS Industries
415a4e47.description:
**Description**
 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for experienced and motivated technologists who possess a unique balance of technical depth and strong interpersonal skills. You will partner some of the worlds largest Automotive and Manufacturing companies, to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud and AI architectures that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. In collaboration with account managers, you will assist in driving growth across a set of global customers in your defined country. As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud\-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mind share and broad use of AWS within enterprise customers. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.
   

  

**Here Are Some Other Qualities We Are Looking For**
 Be great fun to work with.
   

  

 At AWS, we have a credo of “Work hard. Have fun. Make history”. In this role, you will love what you do, and instinctively know how to make work fun. You will be dynamic and creative, and willing to take on any challenge and make a big impact.
   

  

 Enjoy working with large, global customers. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud and AI solutions for a diverse and challenging set of enterprise customers.
   

  

 You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep\-dive education and design exercises to create world\-class solutions built on AWS.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, understanding their business needs and technology challenges to architect customized solutions
* Lead discussions to shape a customer's long\-term technology and AI strategy and guide them on trade\-offs between short\-term fixes and extensible, scalable solutions
* Design end\-to\-end solutions leveraging both technical expertise and business acumen, driving consensus across multiple teams to deliver impactful solutions
* Proactively identify opportunities to accelerate implementation through reusable components, parallel workstreams, etc.
* Share knowledge by developing technical content like sample code, presentations, workshops to exemplify best practices and educate customers
* Drive product innovation by gathering customer feedback, translating needs into clear requirements, and partnering with product teams through development
* Resolve complex technical problems through root cause analysis, both for customers and internally


 A day in the life
   

  

* Review customer requirements and technical challenges, focusing on opportunities to implement complex solutions architectures that can transform business outcomes also leveraging AI capabilities
* Develop proof\-of\-concepts that demonstrate how cloud solutions can transform business processes
* Influence service team leadership and product marketing on the future needs for customers, prioritizing roadmap features and GTM messaging
* Dedicate time to continuous learning about the latest advancements in AWS service capabilities
* Participate in knowledge sharing activities with colleagues, creating field enablement materials to help tech community understand how to integrate cloud solutions into customer architectures


**About The Team**
 The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud and AI journey and work backwards from their industry\-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.
   

  

 The Automotive \& Manufacturing Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to accelerating AWS cloud adoption across strategic automotive and manufacturing accounts. Our mission is to drive tangible business value through focused execution on strategic projects, while enabling scale by up\-skilling broader field teams. We work at the intersection of technology and industry\-specific transformation, partnering closely with account teams, technology specialists, and industry specialist teams to deliver comprehensive solutions.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
* Experience within specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics).
* Experience in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
* Experience working with end user or developer communities
* 2\+ years of working with Data \& AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML (Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning), GenAI (Generative AI), Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
* Experience in IoT, Automotive or Manufacturing domain


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
* Prior Experience of bid and delivery solutioning as well as core delivery must in the relevant technology area
* Expertise in SAP S/4 HANA
* Experience in more than one of the functional workstream (EWM, FICO, SD, SF, Ariba, Customer, IBP) or over\-all solution architect
* Should have worked with onsite teams in business development or delivery.
* Proficient in MS Office products (Project, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)


**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Demonstrate deep knowledge of SAP solutions and appropriate industries to maintain credibility with prospective customers. Provide proof points with relevant customer stories.
* Support RFx completion in support of customer proposals.
* Engaging with Clients in understanding their requirements, scoping, discovering, and defining solutions, explaining business benefits and use cases and a roadmap to meet their goals.
* Creating innovative solution designs that utilise our extensive service offerings.
* Understand client requirements (RFP/ RFI), build synopsis, and have an ability to articulate the customer ask.
* Participation in meetings with internal/external stakeholders (Delivery managers, Account managers and client partners) and Vertical \& Horizontal teams.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong verbal and written communication with out of box thinking abilities.
* Ability to understand Methodologies (Activate, Agile, SDLC, SCRUM) and other industry business fundamentals and ability to showcase a quick learning curve.


**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Worked on implementation RFPs as a solution architect responsible for designing solutions end to end


**What We Look For**
* Prior BD experience (at least 2 Year, overall, 11\-14 years) with exposure to SAP Delivery.
* A strong understanding of SAP and integration with other applications/systems in an IT landscape


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
   

  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect in AWS Industries HCLS segment, you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud and AI architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in\-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.
   

  

 You will partner some of the worlds largest companies, to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud and AI architectures that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. In collaboration with account managers, you will assist in driving growth across a small set of global customers in your defined country. As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud\-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mind\-share and broad use of AWS within enterprise customers. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.
   

  

**Here Are Some Other Qualities We Are Looking For**
 Enjoy working with large, global customers as an active contributor to a diverse team. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud solutions for a diverse and challenging set of enterprise customers.
   

  

 Have a strong understanding of large scale computing solutions. You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep\-dive education and design exercises to create world\-class solutions built on AWS.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Ensure success in building and migrating applications, software and services on the AWS platform
* Architect AI\-ML and Generative AI solutions on AWS
* In partnership with the account management team, formulate and execute a strategy
* Educate customers of all sizes on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud

 Lucidity is a rapidly growing company with a first\-of\-its\-kind and impactful product in cloud storage. **What We Do** 




 Lucidity is a company that provides an automated NoOps disk auto\-scaler for cloud storage across AWS, Azure, and GCP. It addresses over\-provisioned block storage by dynamically scaling capacity, increasing disk utilization to around 80% from 25–35%. This results in cost reductions of up to 70% for businesses. Here's a
 
 video
 
 of what Lucidity does.
 



 Key benefits include:

 Website
 
 \|

 \|
 
 YouTube
 
 \|
 
 LinkedIn
 




 We are growing aggressively and plan to expand our revenue by 5x in the next year. We are passionate about creating something unique, innovative, and big from India for global customers.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We're looking for a
 **Solutions Architect** 
 who can operate as the single technical owner for our most complex, high\-value enterprise accounts \- someone who needs minimal direction to take a customer from technical evaluation through large\-scale production rollout. This is not a role for someone who executes a playbook; it's for someone who can build the playbook, defend it in front of a customer's CTO, and adapt it on the fly when the environment doesn't cooperate.
 



 You'll be the senior\-most technical voice in the room for enterprise accounts \- trusted to make architectural calls independently, to push back on both customers and internal teams when the easy answer isn't the right one, and to represent Lucidity credibly to VP\- and C\-level technical stakeholders.
 


* Independently own end\-to\-end technical architecture and solution design for Lucidity's largest and most complex enterprise engagements, across multi\-cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) environments \- with minimal oversight from leadership.
* Act as the primary technical decision\-maker for your accounts: designing scalable, secure, production\-grade deployments and de\-risking rollouts for the world's largest enterprises without needing hand\-holding.

* Serve as a trusted advisor \- not just answering "how do I deploy this," but shaping how large enterprises think about cloud storage cost, resilience, and operational efficiency as part of their broader cloud strategy.
* Own customer relationships end\-to\-end for your book of accounts: driving time\-to\-value, managing technical risk, and being personally accountable for CSAT and renewal health.
* Anticipate and resolve escalations before they become critical \- you're the person other team members loop in when a deployment gets hard, not the person who escalates upward.
* Mentor and technically guide junior Solutions Engineers/Consultants, review their architecture decisions, and help raise the technical bar of the broader post\-sales team.
* Partner closely with Product and Engineering, feeding back field insights from the most demanding customers to influence roadmap and product hardening.
* Represent Lucidity externally \- presenting at events, running enterprise workshops, and contributing to whitepapers/blogs that establish technical thought leadership.
* Travel to customer sites as needed to close out critical technical milestones.

 of professional experience architecting and operating solutions on cloud infrastructure, with a track record of owning complex technical engagements independently, start to finish.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience writing technical documentation, whitepapers, or presenting at events.
