a97d6d5e.description:
**Join us in building the future of Sandoz.**
 Sandoz continues to go through an exciting and transformative period as a global leader and pioneering provider of sustainable Biosimilar and Generic medicines. As we continue down this new and ambitious path, unique opportunities will present themselves, both professionally and personally. Join us, the future is ours to shape!
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Global Senior Domain Solution Architect Integrations will define solution architectures for programs and projects leveraging approved enterprise integration patterns and platforms. Contribute to the development of architectural standards and provide direction for integration architecture across SAP and non‑SAP domains. Elaborate, document, and communicate solution architectures for medium‑ to large‑scale initiatives with multiple dependent systems.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 Your responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
   

  

* Develop and govern solution architectures for complex integration initiatives spanning SAP and non‑SAP systems.
* Define, maintain, and evolve solution architectures supporting enterprise integrations using established platforms and patterns (e.g., SAP Integration Suite, Boomi, Axway MFT, cloud solutions, APIs, event‑driven architectures).
* Utilize architecture patterns and best practices to recommend appropriate use of integration styles (API‑led, event‑based, batch, file transfer) aligned with business and technical needs.
* Elaborate and document solution architectures in alignment with enterprise architecture principles, security standards, data governance policies, and applicable regulatory requirements (GxP, data integrity, SOX).
* Engage internal delivery teams and external vendors to explain architectural decisions and ensure adherence to architecture governance throughout implementation.
* Collaborate closely with business units, SAP platform and delivery teams, Enterprise Architecture, security, and infrastructure teams to translate business requirements into scalable, robust integration solutions.
* Maintain and enhance integration domain standards, reference architectures, reusable patterns, and documentation using architecture repositories and tooling (LeanIX).
* Contribute to the definition and communication of the SAP \& Integration domain roadmap, aligning requirements with long‑term platform strategy.
* Evaluate emerging integration technologies and vendor solutions for applicability within the enterprise landscape, considering scalability, reliability, security, and operational impact.
* Support improvements in reliability, performance, monitoring, and operational excellence of the enterprise integration landscape.


**Minimum Requirements**
 What you’ll bring to the role:
   

  

* Proven experience in IT delivery and solution or domain architecture roles with strong focus on SAP and enterprise integrations, preferably within the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry
* Proven experience in delivering integration architecture based on enterprise integration platforms (e.g. SAP Integration Suite, SAP Process Orchestration, Boomi, MuleSoft …)
* Solid understanding of SAP on\-prem and cloud architectures and integration options (IDoc, RFC, BAPI, OData, REST, events) and their interaction with non‑SAP platforms.
* Hands‑on experience designing and governing integrations across hybrid landscapes (on‑premise and cloud).
* Experience contributing to complex, multi‑system programs in global enterprise environments.
* Familiarity with enterprise and solution architecture frameworks and methodologies (e.g., TOGAF or equivalent).
* Demonstrated ability to influence without formal authority and collaborate effectively with business, IT, and vendor stakeholders.
* Experience working in global and cross‑cultural environments.
* Comfortable working in complex, evolving landscapes with a pragmatic and solution‑oriented mindset.


**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology Business Administration, or related business field; (Master’s degree is preferred)


**Languages**

**The role sits between sales and engineering, and is accountable to both** 



  


 A high\-growth, VC\-backed SaaS company is hiring its founding India team through Flexiple. Deals are increasingly won or lost on whether a prospect's technical evaluator believes the product will work in their environment, and right now the founders are personally doing that call. It does not scale past about here. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps global companies build high\-performing teams and GCCs in India.
 


  


**What the week contains** 



  


 Technical discovery with prospects, which mostly means finding out what they actually have rather than what the RFP says. Building demonstrations against a customer's real constraints. Running proofs of concept and being straight about what did not work. Writing up integration requirements clearly enough that engineering can act on them without a second meeting.
 


  


**The uncomfortable part** 



  


 Telling a sales lead the deal will not work as scoped. That happens, and the people who last in this role are the ones who do it early rather than letting a proof of concept quietly fail three weeks later.

* 4 to 8 years in solutions engineering, pre\-sales engineering or a customer\-facing technical role

* Composure in front of a sceptical technical audience


  


 Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Delhi NCR, Mumbai or Chennai, or remote within India, with some travel to customer sites. A screening call, a technical conversation, a live scenario, then time with the founding team.

d3a0dc27.description:
**Overview**
 TekWissen is a global workforce management provider throughout India and many other countries in the world. The below client is a global company with shared ideals and a deep sense of family. From our earliest days as a pioneer of modern transportation, we have sought to make the world a better place – one that benefits lives, communities and the planet
   

  

**Job Title: Architect Senior Specialist**
**Location: Chennai**
**Work Type: Hybrid (4 Days work From Office)**
**Position Description**
* Modernization Architect (GCP) We are executing a high\-visibility, enterprise\-wide digital transformation to migrate our mission\-critical systems from a legacy Mainframe ecosystem (DB2 z/OS, COBOL, JCL) to a modern, cloud\-native architecture on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* As the Mainframe Modernization Architect (GCP), you will act as the principal technical authority for this transition.
* Partnering directly with our Senior Technical Product Management team, you will design the technical roadmap to untangle decades of legacy business logic without disrupting ongoing business operations.
* You are the bridge between our veteran DB2 administrators and our modern full\-stack Java development teams.
* You will not just be "lifting and shifting"; you will be fundamentally re\-architecting how our business processes data.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Architectural Strategy \& Design
* Design and own the end\-to\-end target state architecture on GCP, utilizing Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL (or AlloyDB), Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), and Cloud Run.
* Architect a safe, iterative "Strangler Fig" migration pattern, entirely avoiding high\-risk "Big Bang" cutovers. Define the High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) posture for the new cloud environment, translating Mainframe RTO/RPO expectations into GCP realities. Database \& Data Layer Transformation
* Lead the complex heterogeneous database migration from Mainframe DB2 to GCP PostgreSQL.
* Architect solutions for systemic data translation challenges, including EBCDIC to UTF\-8/ASCII conversion, packed decimal transformations, and proprietary DB2 constraint mappings.
* Implement and manage Change Data Capture (CDC) pipelines (e.g., Google Datastream, Debezium, Striim) to ensure bidrectional or unidirectional real\-time data synchronization during the coexistence phase.
* Guide the engineering teams in transitioning from DB2 pessimistic locking models to PostgreSQL's Multi\-Version Concurrency Control (MVCC) to eliminate lock contention.
* Compute \& Batch Modernization
* Map and translate heavy Mainframe batch processing (JCL, scheduled jobs) into modern, stateless, and restartable cloud patterns using Java Spring Batch, Cloud Composer (Airflow), and GCP Dataflow.
* Advise Java engineering teams on refactoring heavy legacy Stored Procedures (SQL PL) into scalable Spring Boot microservices.
* Technical Leadership \& Mentorship
* Act as the central technical translator between legacy Mainframe engineers and modern cloud developers.
* Establish FinOps best practices to ensure the newly migrated architecture is highly cost\-optimized, shifting the team from a fixed\-MIPS mindset to cloud consumption models.
* Design and oversee the "Dual Run" (Shadow Testing) strategy to guarantee absolute functional and financial equivalence before legacy deprecation.


**Experience**
**Required Qualifications:**
* 10\+ years of experience in enterprise software engineering or architecture.
* 3\+ years of direct, hands\-on experience leading Heterogeneous Database Migrations (specifically from Mainframe DB2/zOS or Oracle to PostgreSQL).
* The Legacy Pillar
* Deep understanding of Mainframe architectures, specifically IBM DB2, JCL, and COBOL ecosystems.
* Proven ability to analyze legacy code and extract undocumented business rules.
* The Modern Pillar
* Expert\-level proficiency in PostgreSQL internals (query optimization, autovacuum tuning, connection pooling strategies like PgBouncer).
* Expert\-level proficiency in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), specifically around managed databases (Cloud SQL, AlloyDB), networking, and IAM security.
* Strong architectural understanding of the modern Java ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring Batch, JPA/Hibernate, RESTful APIs).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Certifications: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect or Professional Cloud Database Engineer.
* Tooling: Experience with automated legacy\-to\-cloud refactoring toolsets (e.g., Google Cloud G4, Advanced, or similar).


**Skills Required**
* Mainframe DB, GCP


**Skills Preferred**
* Java, COBOL


**Experience Required**
* Senior Specialist Exp.: 10\+ years in IT; 7\+ years in concentration


**Experience Preferred**
* Migration from Mainframe(COBOL / DB/2\) to GCP (Java / Postgres DB)


**Education Required**
* Bachelor's Degree

96ff4fab.title: Technical Program Manager III, Paragon
96ff4fab.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Would you like to work on one of the world's largest transactional distributed systems? How about working with customers and peers from the entire range of Amazon's business on cool new features? Whether you're passionate about building highly scalable and reliable systems or a software developer who likes to solve business problems, Selling Partner Services (SPS) is the place for you. Our team is responsible for Case Management System. Case management is a mix of human investigation combined with automation. We aim to be the best Human\-In\-The\-Loop (HITL) system that is the default choice for new programs aiming to leverage HITL systems in their business.  

  

As a TPM in this role you will be responsible for scoping and delivering large projects end\-to\-end. Responsibilities include collection of business and systems requirements from internal and external customers, writing specifications, driving project schedules from design to release, and managing the production launch. You will lead and coordinate design/implementation efforts between internal teams and outside merchants and vendors to develop optimal solutions. You will be expected to make appropriate tradeoffs to optimize time\-to\-market, clearly communicate goals, roles, responsibilities, and desired outcomes to internal cross\-functional and remote project teams. Case management is a multi\-tenant system with hundreds of tenants, being used by tens of thousands of users and solving hundreds of millions of cases per year.  

  

The right candidate will possess a strong technical program management background, will have demonstrated experience leading medium to large projects, and will have a well\-rounded technical background in current web technologies. You must be able to thrive and succeed in an entrepreneurial environment, and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities. This means you are not only able to develop and drive high\-level strategic initiatives, but can also roll up your sleeves, dig in and get the job done. As a TPM, you will anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, anticipate and make tradeoffs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints. An ability to take large, complex projects and break them down into manageable pieces, develop functional specifications, then deliver them in a successful and timely manner is expected. Maturity, high judgment, negotiation skills, ability to influence, analytical talent and leadership are essential to success in this role.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 7\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 3\+ years of software development experience
* 5\+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi\-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

e14e6a99.description:
**Purpose**
 Lead MPL Solution Design for customer pursuits that require advanced engineering knowhow. Designs solutions for new markets (geographies / customers) jointly with business development \& operations / operations excellence teams. Supports standardization \& proof of concept building for automation initiatives, using methodology provided from global and Regional teams for solutioning jointly, with continuous improvement mindset.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
- Own Solution design to personally take the lead to:

* Capture core data and assumptions that are required to design, cost and price the solution for the customer. This includes the process for capturing all customer insights that might be relevant for this pursuit or future upselling opportunities
* Develop detailed designs for the solution incorporating the scope of services, operating model, resource models, operating cost estimates, recommended selling price, estimated value for the client and draft P\&L for Maersk
* Calculate MPL size/scope requirements based on product data mainly provided as part of a customer RFQ
* Create process flows for key activities
* Providing engineering solution and visualization for proposed solutions as part of technical response in RFQ


- Maintain close links with LEAN and Business Process Engineering experts to ensure LEAN methodologies are transferred to new commercial opportunities within geo scope .

- Provide innovative solutions and ideas to help create the most competitive offerings .

- Be an active participant within the MPL Solution Design Community:

* Capture and share knowledge / best practices throughout the organization to support short and long term success .
* Speak up and share both supportive and critical views in a way that fosters a dynamic and engaging pursuit of continuous improvement
* Support development of automation proof of concepts
* Guide Solution design teams in Area on new business opportunities; i.e., RFP response, strategic cross country project focus, CAPEX, presentations materials, technical documentation and support
* Drive knowledge sharing and capability building L\&D activities for solution design in the wider organization, creating in\-house talent pool with relevant People function support.


**Critical Competencies**
* 5\+ years’ experience in design of MPL solutions
* Highly experienced in designing solutions for core MPL verticals
* Extremely skilled MPL solution engineer, who has deep understanding of making process changes on productivity and financials
* Exposure of working in MPL or logistics operations including implementation
* Innovative in reaching conclusions and making recommendations based on limited and/or ambiguous data

7f76f5ee.title: Software Architect - SambaStack
7f76f5ee.description:
The era of pervasive AI has arrived. In this era, organizations will use generative AI to unlock hidden value in their data, accelerate processes, reduce costs, drive efficiency and innovation to fundamentally transform their businesses and operations at scale.
   

  

 SambaNova Suite™ is the first full\-stack, generative AI platform, from chip to model, optimized for enterprise and government organizations. Powered by the intelligent SN40L chip, the SambaNova Suite is a fully integrated platform, delivered on\-premises or in the cloud, combined with state\-of\-the\-art open\-source models that can be easily and securely fine\-tuned using customer data for greater accuracy. Once adapted with customer data, customers retain model ownership in perpetuity, so they can turn generative AI into one of their most valuable assets.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We help enterprises and service providers host their own AI inference platforms, powered by our state\-of\-the\-art RDU (Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit) hardware architecture. Our cloud\-agnostic, enterprise\-grade inference serving platform enables seamless deployment, management, and scaling of foundation model workloads at production scale.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Software Architect on the SambaStack team, you will define the technical direction of the platform, shaping how it evolves to meet the demands of the world's most demanding enterprise AI workloads. You will own the cross\-cutting architectural decisions that span teams and shape the platform's long\-term trajectory.
   

  

 This is a high\-impact, high\-visibility role at the intersection of:
   

  

* AI infrastructure
* Enterprise software
* Systems architecture and design
* Developer experience


**Responsibilities**
 Some of your responsibilities will include:
   

  

* Own the end\-to\-end technical architecture of the SambaStack inference platform, ensuring it meets enterprise\-grade standards for scalability, reliability, and performance.
* Define and drive architectural strategy across engineering teams, aligning long\-term platform direction with product and business objectives.
* Lead design reviews for major new capabilities and cross\-cutting system changes, providing authoritative technical guidance and raising the quality bar across the SambaStack engineering organization.
* Proactively identify and resolve systemic risks, including performance bottlenecks, reliability gaps, and scaling constraints, before they impact customers.
* Establish and evolve architectural standards, patterns, and best practices across the SambaStack engineering organization.
* Partner with ML Engineers, Product Managers, QA, and DevOps to translate complex, ambiguous requirements into sound architectural decisions.
* Serve as a technical thought leader and mentor, growing the architectural thinking and design skills of Software Engineers across the team.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to inform the platform's technical roadmap.
* Architect new systems, components, and capabilities to solve new and interesting problems in the AI inference space.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 12\+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time in a role with organization\-wide technical influence.
* Proven track record of owning large\-scale distributed systems architectures end\-to\-end from design to production.
* Expertise building backend systems in Python, Go, or Rust.
* Expert\-level understanding of Kubernetes, including Operators, Helm Charts, and cluster\-scale resource management.
* Strong command of distributed systems principles: consistency, fault tolerance, observability, and performance at scale.
* Demonstrated experience setting technical direction across multiple teams and driving cross\-functional alignment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills: Able to clearly articulate complex architectural decisions to both engineering and non\-technical audiences.
* Track record of mentoring more junior engineers and elevating team\-wide engineering quality.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Deep familiarity with AI inference serving, orchestration, and the infrastructure challenges of LLM workloads at production scale.
* Experience designing systems for custom or novel hardware accelerators (e.g., dataflow architectures, GPUs, TPUs).
* Background in ML application optimization and productionization.
* Experience building cloud\-native platforms for enterprise customers with stringent SLA and compliance requirements.
* Familiarity with AI coding assistants and the developer tooling ecosystem.
* Experience at a high\-growth AI infrastructure company.


 Base Salary Range:
   

  

 Base Pay Range
   

  

 ₹10,300,000—₹12,500,000 INR
   

  

**Submission Guidelines**
 Please note that in order to be considered an applicant for any position at SambaNova Systems, you must submit an application form for each position for which you believe you are qualified.
   

  

**EEO Policy**
 SambaNova Systems is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard basis of age (40 and over), color, disability, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, national origin/ancestry, race, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding), sexual orientation, and any other applicable status protected by federal, state, or local laws.
   

  

**Benefits Summary For US\-Based, Full\-Time Employment Positions**
 SambaNova offers a competitive total rewards package, including the base salary, plus equity and benefits. We cover 95% premium coverage for employee medical insurance, and 77% premium coverage for dependents and offer a Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contribution. We also offer Dental, Vision, Short/Long term Disability, Basic Life, Voluntary Life, and AD\&D insurance plans in addition to Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options like Health Care, Limited Purpose, and Dependent Care. Our library of well\-being benefits available to you and your dependents includes a full subscription to Headspace, Gympass\+ membership with access to physical gyms, One Medical membership, counseling services with an Employee Assistance Program, and much more.

8cca1d65.title: Delivery Manager, SEO & GEO
8cca1d65.description:
About Geology
 
 Geology is a marketing lab, not an agency. We build AI agents that do the work agencies still do by hand, and we point them at SEO and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization: getting a brand cited inside ChatGPT and Google's AI Overviews, which is where a fast\-growing share of buying research now happens).
 



 Both founders are from IIT Bombay and have built companies before. This is the newest one, the team is small, and whoever joins now will be one of the first few people in it.
   




 About the role
 
 You run delivery for our client accounts: the analysis, the deliverables, the reporting, and the client relationship at working level.
 



 Most of the heavy lifting is done by agents we build and maintain. Your job is to run them well, judge whether what comes out is any good, and turn it into work the client acts on. That judgement is the part no agent does yet, and it is the job.
 



 You will work directly with the founders.
   




 Key responsibilities
 * Own delivery for a few client accounts: what ships, at what standard, and when
* Use our AI agents to produce the client work, across technical audits, content, reporting, AI\-visibility tracking and off\-site execution
* Review what the agents produce, decide what actually matters to the client, and take it the last stretch yourself
* Present the work on client calls, agree next steps, and follow up until they ship
* Keep delivery on track: track what is open, and chase access, approvals and blockers to closure
* Help improve the agents you work with


 What we are looking for
 * 1 to 3 years delivering work to clients or stakeholders and owning the relationship at working level. Agency, consulting or programme management all count, and it does not have to be marketing
* Clear written English, good enough for documents that go to a client
* Comfortable presenting work and taking questions on it live
* Consistent follow\-through. What gets committed to on a call actually happens
* Strong with data: spreadsheets, reading a data set accurately, and checking a number before you present it
* Experience with tools like GitHub and Claude Code, or the ability to work out how. You should be comfortable setting a tool up from its documentation and working out why something is not running, since a good deal of what you will use here does not exist yet


 Good to have
 * SEO or GEO experience. Useful, and genuinely not required: we will teach it
* Having used Claude Code, Cursor or similar agentic tools
* Basic Python or scripting
* Agency experience


 What we offer
 * ₹10,00,000 to ₹18,00,000 per annum, depending on experience and skill
* Based in Jaipur, working in the same room as the founders
* Direct work with repeat founders, early in building this company, with no layer in between
* The chance to learn how custom AI agents are actually built and run in production work, rather than reading about it


 How to apply
 
 Send your LinkedIn and a two to three minute video. The video brief is short, and it is worth reading before you record.
 



 Apply: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe8mPZ3YneU37xnLB2\_lj\-An2Vhz\-\_P5BOv6ve3OA9HRuW7kQ/viewform

d9995087.title: Oracle Cloud EPM Lead – Remote (India)
d9995087.description:
**Location:** 
 Remote (India: various cities)
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



  





 At CloudAvanti, we are a premier Oracle Cloud implementation partner with the expertise of a global firm and the agility, flexibility and personalization of a boutique. We help clients across North America modernize their ERP, HCM, EPM and SCM with Oracle Cloud, delivering outcomes that blend speed, precision and lasting value.
 



  





 We set the bar high and deliver work that meets it. If you’re an Oracle Cloud Procurement Functional Consultant who thrives on solving complex sourcing and purchasing challenges, takes ownership of your work and wants to work alongside experienced, motivated teammates, you’ll feel right at home here.
 



  





**What You’ll Be Doing** 



* Own end\-to\-end functional solution architecture and design for Oracle EPM Cloud engagements, ensuring solutions are scalable, well\-governed and aligned to leading practices across modules such as Planning, Financial Consolidation and Close (FCCS), Account Reconciliation (ARCS), Tax Reporting (TRCS), Enterprise Data Management (EDMCS), Narrative Reporting and Profitability and Cost Management (PCM).
* Serve as a client\-facing lead on EPM engagements, building trusted relationships with finance, FP\&A and executive stakeholders and owning overall solution and relationship health.
* Lead and mentor a team of EPM consultants, providing technical guidance, quality oversight and career development support.
* Lead complex requirements, design and prototype workshops, guiding clients through leading practices for planning, budgeting, forecasting, consolidation, financial close, account reconciliation and tax reporting.
* Translate ambiguous or evolving business needs into practical, fit\-to\-standard EPM solutions that strengthen controls and improve the quality and timeliness of information available to decision\-makers.
* Remain hands\-on throughout delivery while leading and overseeing configuration, testing and deployment activities across the project team, troubleshooting complex issues and ensuring quality, consistency and adherence to timelines.
* Design and oversee data integration strategy between Oracle EPM Cloud, Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and other source systems, with a focus on data quality, controls and repeatability.
* Lead solution and design reviews, challenge unnecessary complexity and ensure configurations and deliverables meet CloudAvanti's quality standards.
* Lead critical project activities including functional testing, UAT readiness, cutover, go\-live and stabilization.
* Support presales and pursuit activities, including scoping, estimating, demonstrations and solutioning for new and existing clients.
* Partner with delivery and account leadership to identify opportunities for account growth and additional client value.
* Provide post\-implementation guidance, strategic optimization recommendations and knowledge transfer to client teams.
* Stay ahead of the Oracle EPM Cloud roadmap, AI capabilities and emerging functionality, advising clients and internal teams on adoption strategy.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 8\+ years of hands\-on Oracle EPM Cloud implementation experience, including significant solution leadership responsibility across multiple end\-to\-end implementations.
* Demonstrated experience owning functional solution architecture across two or more of the following: Planning, Financial Consolidation and Close (FCCS), Account Reconciliation (ARCS), Tax Reporting (TRCS), Enterprise Data Management (EDMCS), Narrative Reporting and/or Profitability and Cost Management (PCM).
* Deep hands\-on Oracle EPM Cloud configuration experience, with the ability to independently design, configure, review and troubleshoot complex solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to lead integrated EPM solution design across multiple applications and complex finance processes.
* Experience mentoring, coaching or managing consulting teams, with a track record of developing talent.
* Experience supporting presales activities, including scoping, estimating and solution design for EPM pursuits.
* Strong executive presence, with a proven ability to build and sustain trusted relationships with senior finance stakeholders, including North American clients.
* Strong functional understanding of finance and FP\&A processes, including financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, consolidation, financial close, account reconciliation and/or tax reporting.
* Experience with Oracle EPM data integration capabilities and integrating EPM Cloud with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP or other source systems.
* Familiarity with EPM Automate and other Oracle EPM administration and automation capabilities.
* Oracle EPM Cloud certification is considered an asset.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence both technical and non\-technical audiences across time zones.
* A collaborative, solution\-focused mindset with a strong sense of ownership and commitment to delivering quality outcomes.



  





**Why You’ll Love Working Here** 



* **Premier cloud implementation partner experience:** 
 work alongside some of the most talented and experienced Oracle Cloud professionals in the market.
* **More ownership, less bureaucracy:** 
 work directly with clients and CloudAvanti leaders, own meaningful workstreams and see your recommendations move quickly from idea to execution.
* **Meaningful impact with a bias towards action:** 
 collaborate directly with decision\-makers and see your solutions come to life.
* **Room to grow:** 
 we’re expanding fast, creating opportunities to shape delivery, lead projects, mentor others and take on greater responsibility as you grow.
* **Build what’s next:** 
 help shape how we deliver Oracle Cloud using AI, automation and proprietary accelerators designed to improve delivery quality and speed.
* **Interesting, varied work:** 
 work with clients across industries and tackle different business, process and technology challenges.
* **A culture that backs you:** 
 transparency, innovation, accountability and high standards are how we work.
* **Flexibility that works for you:** 
 remote\-first, with client\-based travel and opportunities to connect in person for key sessions and team events



  





**Who We Are** 




 CloudAvanti is a premier Oracle Cloud systems integrator helping North American clients modernize with confidence. We combine enterprise\-grade delivery with a boutique level of service, bringing speed, clarity and partnership to every engagement.
 



  





**Ready to build something great with us?** 




 Apply today and let’s talk about how you can help us deliver Oracle Cloud solutions that move clients forward with precision and impact.

 8\. Quality \& Reliability

* Ensure performance, security, logging and monitoring are built into solutions.
* Review production readiness before releases.
* Drive resolution of technical debt and recurring production issues.


 What We Are Looking For
 * **9–14 years of software development experience** 
 , with at least 
 **3 years in a Technical Lead / Senior Technical Lead role** 
 .
* Strong hands\-on experience in 
 **React and Python** 
 .
* Good understanding of backend development using 
 **FastAPI, Flask, Django or equivalent** 
 .
* Strong experience developing 
 **REST APIs, microservices and enterprise applications** 
 .
* Hands\-on experience with 
 **AWS cloud** 
 .
* Practical experience with 
 **Kafka or other event\-streaming technologies** 
 .
* Experience with 
 **SQL and relational databases** 
 .
* Experience with 
 **Snowflake or other cloud data platforms** 
  is preferred.
* Good understanding of data pipelines, ETL/ELT and real\-time data processing.
* Experience with Docker, CI/CD and cloud deployment practices.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns and API/integration architecture.
* Experience leading and mentoring software development teams.
* Strong debugging, problem\-solving and technical decision\-making skills.


 Manufacturing / Industry Experience – Preferred
 
 Candidates with experience in any of the following will have an advantage:
 


* Manufacturing Digital Transformation
* MES / MOM
* Industry 4\.0 / IIoT
* Smart Factory
* Production \& Shop Floor Applications
* Machine/IoT Data Integration
* Quality \& Maintenance Applications
* ERP–MES–IoT Integration
* Factory Analytics / OEE
* Digital Twin
* Automotive / Industrial Manufacturing


 Why Join BWS?
 
 You will have the opportunity to:
 


* Build 
 **real\-world digital solutions for manufacturing companies** 
 .
* Work across 
 **software, cloud, data, IoT and AI** 
 .
* Lead a growing engineering team.
* Work closely with manufacturing experts, architects, customers and business teams.
* Build scalable solutions that become part of the 
 **digital backbone of modern factories** 
 .



**If you are a hands\-on Technical Lead who enjoys solving complex engineering problems, leading developers and building digital solutions that impact real manufacturing operations, we would like to hear from you.** 




**Interested candidates can share their updated CV to hiring@kashtechllc.com**

**Job Description**
 In this role, the Domain Architect will be responsible for managing team for one of Solution Area and bring thought leadership in customer engagement. Candidate will also be responsible for quality delivery and delivery project KPI tracking and adhering.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
 Manage Nokia Internal Stake holder engagements with solution capabilities from multiple sources and technologies.
   

  

* Build understanding and preference for Nokia products and solutions by influencing regional team decisions and strategic direction.
* Demonstrate significant operational as well as commercial knowledge of clients' business and uses this to build credibility as well as identify sales opportunities.
* Define new \& innovative delivery model and package integrated solutions not only limited to Nokia Net's portfolio Leads training, development, and co\-ordination of activities of more junior consultants, and regularly leads project teams.
* System Integration Project and execution plan management.
* Provide delivery value proposition \& model.
* Ensuring competent resources on time every time.
* Provide Presales support for portfolio.


**Key Skills And Experience**
 Must have:
   

  

* 10\+ years of experience in IMS Projects with BE/B.Tech or equivalent degree.
* Experience in IMS Core Equipment: NTAS, SBC, CFX
* Adequate knowledge of IMS Network and functionality of products such as Openstack SBC, Vmware SBC, RMS SBC, Cloud CBIS, CBAM. Should be familiar with SBC call flows \& KPI’s.
* Experience in Cloud NTAS.
* Understanding customer technical requirements, Protocol Specs, Method of Procedure.
* Linux and Cloud Infra knowledge is must.


 Good to have:
   

  

* Basic understanding of Project Management skill is an advantage
* Computer: MS Office, Teams


**About Us**
**Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.**
 Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.
   

  

 Learn more about life at Nokia .
   

  

**Our recruitment process**
 We act inclusively and respect the uniqueness of people. Our employment decisions are made regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. We are committed to a culture of inclusion built upon our core value of respect.
   

  

 If you’re interested in this role but don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences enrich our teams, and you may be just the right candidate for this or another opportunity.
   

  

 The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates. Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia .

9a80a2aa.title: Presales Specialist
9a80a2aa.description:
**Company Description** 
 Asset Tree Homes, founded in 2005, is a Chennai\-based construction company known for its strong commitment to quality and timely delivery. Over the years, the company has successfully completed more than 40 high\-quality construction projects. Now in its 15th year, Asset Tree Homes continues to grow as a trusted name in residential and commercial development. The organization is driven by a passion for building well\-designed, durable spaces that meet the expectations of modern customers.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Presales Specialist role at Asset Tree Homes is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Chennai. The Presales Specialist will engage with prospective customers, understand their requirements, and present suitable project offerings, features, and pricing options. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include conducting consultations, preparing and delivering product presentations, responding to inquiries, and supporting the sales team with proposals and documentation. The role also involves coordinating site visits, gathering customer feedback, and working closely with marketing and sales to refine messaging and improve lead conversion. The Presales Specialist will maintain accurate records in CRM tools and contribute to continuous improvement of presales processes.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to understand customer needs, interpret project data, and support decision\-making.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills to present solutions clearly, handle queries, and collaborate with internal teams.
* Candidates should possess Consulting and Presales skills to provide tailored recommendations, build value propositions, and support the sales cycle.
* Candidates should possess Customer Service skills to manage relationships, ensure a positive experience, and respond promptly to concerns.
* Relevant experience in real estate, construction, or property sales/presales is beneficial.
* Proficiency with CRM tools, presentation software, and basic MS Office applications is preferred.
* Ability to work on\-site, manage multiple leads simultaneously, and meet timelines and targets.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, engineering, or a relevant field is an advantage.

2f5aa24a.title: Senior Solution Consultant – Workday Adaptive Planning
2f5aa24a.description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**
 We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
   

  

**About The Team**
 APAC Solution Consulting team is expanding into India! We are hiring GTM roles including Presales Solution Consultant (Planning) to grow our presence in the country.
   

  

 More than 700 global corporations and several millions of end\-users are users of Workday products in India. We are building on this strong base and work closely with our partners to bring our solutions, to the local organisations! We believe there is an increased opportunity to expand our Financial and Workforce Planning business portfolio. Increasingly, organisations that want to transform the way they operate are replacing legacy systems with Workday’s SaaS Enterprise Management applications.
   

  

 If you are a Presales Solution Consultant with domain expertise in Enterprise Planning \& Analytics and have industry experience, who is passionate about changing the way people work in this age of AI, we’d love to speak to you.
   

  

 As a member of our diverse and skilled Presales team, you will sit at the intersection of Sales, Product Management, Consulting, and Marketing. Your mission is to bring the value of Workday solutions to life, showcasing how the office of the CFO and CHRO can be revolutionized through next\-generation SaaS planning and consolidation applications.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Workday is looking for a senior\-level technical professional with deep expertise in Enterprise Planning and Analytics. You will leverage your product and industry knowledge to provide functional expertise throughout the sales process for our largest enterprise prospects.
   

  

 You will lead discovery workshops with prospective customers to uncover business requirements and value. You will provide authoritative overview and deep\-dive product demonstrations and position the unique value of Workday Adaptive Planning. You will conduct executive\-level presentations and provide trusted advice and mentorship as a planning subject matter expert. We also assist in responding to RFPs, participate in Workday events such as webinars, customer forums, and industry conferences and tradeshows.
   

  

***Key Responsibilities:***
* Strategic Discovery: Lead workshops with prospective customers to uncover business requirements, current pain points, and potential value.
* High\-Impact Demonstrations/Presentations: Deliver authoritative deep\-dive product demonstrations and executive\-level presentations that position the unique value of Workday Adaptive Planning.
* Technical Excellence: Develop and champion Workday\-based solutions, which may include rapid prototyping, creating mini\-applications, or delivering complex Proofs of Concept (POC).
* Trusted Advisor: Build deep relationships with C\-level stakeholders—specifically the office of the CFO—offering mentorship and credible subject matter expertise.
* Sales Partnership: Collaborate with Account Executives to lead RFP/RFI responses and develop winning value propositions.


**About You**
**Basic Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of overall professional experience, including at least 5 years working with Finance Planning, Budgeting and Forecasting systems in enterprise environments.
* 3\+ years’ experience and proven track record in a Presales Solution Consulting role, ideally within a software/SaaS environment.
* 3\+ years extensive experience presenting to C\-level executives with the ability to communicate influentially.
* Strong understanding of the Financial Planning and Consolidation functional areas as well as Workforce Planning.


**Other Qualifications:**
* Exposure to Planning solutions from Anaplan, Onestream, IBM Planning Analytics/TM1, SAP and Oracle would be an advantage
* Knowledge of Generative and Agentic AI as applied to the Finance domain and experience in positioning embedded or built\-on\-AI solutions to business and technology stakeholders
* Experience engaging with medium and large enterprises across various industries such as FSI, Higher Education, Healthcare, Government, Professional Services and Retail.
* Experience in Workforce, Headcount, Sales and Operational Planning will be desirable.
* You are an exceptional, dynamic presenter with strong communication and influencing skills, specifically to a C\-level Finance leadership audience
* You possess credibility and passion for presentations and product demonstrations around FP\&A technology solutions
* You thrive under pressure and can manage multiple, simultaneous engagements with different prospects
* You are a "continuous learner" who is passionate about innovation and creative problem\-solving.
* Applicants must have willingness to travel up to 50% of the time to engage with customers and partners in the field.
* You are adaptable and excited to work in a high growth, evolving organization.
* Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).


**Our Approach to Flexible Work**
 With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in\-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in\-office each week, we simply
 **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** 
 with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.
   

  

 At Workday, we are committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring experience where all candidates can fully demonstrate their skills. If you require assistance or an accommodation at any point, please email accommodations@workday.com.
   

  

**Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Workday about our Employee Referral process!**
 At Workday, we value our candidates’ privacy and data security. Workday will never ask candidates to apply to jobs through websites that are not Workday Careers.
   

  

 Please be aware of sites that may ask for you to input your data in connection with a job posting that appears to be from Workday but is not.
   

  

 In addition, Workday will never ask candidates to pay a recruiting fee, or pay for consulting or coaching services, in order to apply for a job at Workday.

c96e1568.description:
While technology is the heart of our business, a global and diverse culture is the heart of our success. We love our people and we take pride in catering them to a culture built on transparency, diversity, integrity, learning and growth.
   

  

 If working in an environment that encourages you to innovate and excel, not just in professional but personal life, interests you\- you would enjoy your career with Quantiphi!
   

  

**Experience Range:** 
 8\-12 years
   

  

**Location:** 
 Mumbai/Bangalore
   

  

 We are looking for a strategic and execution\-focused Client Solution Partner to lead pre\-sales and solutioning for our Customer Experience (CX) practice across the US and Canada. This role will be instrumental in driving AI\-led contact center transformations powered by Google GECX and the broader Google ecosystem. You will partner closely with sales, alliances, delivery, and client stakeholders to shape compelling, differentiated solutions that modernize contact centers using GenAI, automation, analytics, and cloud\-native capabilities.
   

  

 This is a high\-impact, client\-facing leadership role requiring deep domain expertise in Contact Center transformation and strong commercial acumen.
   

  

**Role \& Responsibilities**
* Pre\-Sales \& Solution Leadership
* Lead end\-to\-end solutioning for CX transformation opportunities across US \& Canada.
* Engage with C\-level stakeholders (CXOs, Heads of Contact Center, CIOs, Digital leaders) to understand business objectives and translate them into AI\-led transformation roadmaps.
* Design differentiated solutions leveraging Google’s CX stack (CCaaS, Conversational Agents, Agent Assist, Analytics).
* Own RFP/RFI responses, solution narratives, architecture vision, and pricing alignment.
* Drive solution workshops, discovery sessions, and executive presentations
* Domain Advisory \& Thought Leadership
* Act as a trusted advisor to clients on:
* AI\-powered virtual agents (voice \& chat)
* Agent augmentation and productivity\-Workforce optimization \& routing modernization
* Omnichannel CX transformation
* Contact center analytics \& insights
* Articulate business value (cost reduction, containment, AHT reduction, CSAT improvement, revenue uplift).
* Represent the practice in industry forums, client events, and partner engagements.
* GTM \& Practice Enablement
* Collaborate with sales leaders to shape account strategy and pipeline development.
* Develop reusable solution assets, industry playbooks, and accelerators.
* Partner with Google alliance teams to co\-sell and strengthen ecosystem alignment.
* Support marketing initiatives (case studies, POVs, webinars, event content).
* Commercial \& Engagement Ownership
* Own solution integrity from pre\-sales through transition to delivery.
* Ensure alignment between proposed architecture, scope, and execution feasibility.
* Provide effort estimation guidance and defend solution economics during deal cycles.
* Support deal negotiations with a value\-first positioning.


**Required Skills**
* 8\+ years of experience in Contact Center / CX transformation.
* Strong experience in CCaaS platforms (Google, Genesys, NICE, Five9, Amazon Connect, etc.).
* Demonstrated experience with AI/GenAI\-driven CX solutions (virtual agents, agent assist, conversational AI).
* Proven track record of leading large, complex pre\-sales engagements.
* Experience working with enterprise clients across US and Canada markets.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to articulate ROI and value realization.
* Excellent executive communication and storytelling skills


*If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over\-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us* 
*!*

09be84b5.title: Security Solution Architect
09be84b5.description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
   

  

**About The Role**
 At Qualys, we’re redefining how organizations secure their IT environments through a unified SaaS platform. Our platform uniquely combines detection, response, and remediation, enabling customers to not only identify threats but actively eliminate them.
   

  

 We are looking for a Security Solutions Architect who blends deep technical expertise with business acumen. This role is ideal for someone who can operate as a trusted advisor, influence technical strategy, and drive measurable customer outcomes across security, compliance, and risk domains.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Act as a strategic technical advisor to enterprise customers across vulnerability management, threat detection \& response, compliance, and cloud/app security
* Partner with Sales, TAMs, and customer stakeholders to drive technical wins and expansion opportunities
* Architect end\-to\-end security solutions aligned to customer environments and business goals
* Lead high\-impact Proof of Value (PoV) engagements to demonstrate platform capabilities
* Translate customer requirements into scalable architectures and deployment strategies
* Identify gaps between current and desired security posture, and position solutions to bridge them
* Deliver executive\-level workshops, architecture sessions, and technical briefings
* Create reusable assets such as reference architectures, onboarding playbooks, and best practices
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmap based on field insights
* Stay ahead of evolving threats, technologies, and market trends


**What We’re Looking For**
 We want someone who can connect deep technical expertise with real\-world business impact.
   

  

* Strong experience in customer\-facing roles (pre\-sales, post\-sales, or advisory)
* Proven ability to design and articulate complex security architectures
* Experience driving technical wins and handling high\-stakes customer scenarios
* Excellent communication skills—able to engage both engineers and executives
* High ownership, curiosity, and ability to operate in fast\-paced environments


**Technical Expertise (One or More Areas)**
 Infrastructure \& Endpoint Security
   

  

* Vulnerability management, patching, asset discovery
* Policy compliance, configuration management
* Endpoint detection \& response (EDR)


 Cloud Security
   

  

* AWS / Azure / GCP architecture
* Cloud posture management, misconfigurations, and risk mitigation
* Identity, workload, and container security


 Application Security
   

  

* SAST, DAST, API security
* Container security and DevSecOps practices
* Familiarity with OWASP and MITRE frameworks


**Additional Experience**
* Hands\-on experience with Qualys or similar platforms
* Understanding of industry standards (ISO, NIST, CIS, etc.)
* Ability to map security controls to compliance frameworks
* Experience influencing product direction through customer feedback

1d02b86c.title: Solution Architect
1d02b86c.description:
**About Zuora**
 At Zuora, we help businesses grow smarter and adapt faster. Our platform powers modern business models — from subscriptions and usage\-based pricing to AI\-driven and outcome\-based offerings — helping companies launch new products, automate complex billing, and unlock predictable, recurring revenue.
   

  

 We’ve led the Subscription Economy for more than a decade. Now we’re evolving again by building the definitive platform for quote to cash and helping companies monetize their products and services with an adaptable, AI\-ready foundation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The solution architect is a key member of the professional services team responsible for the design and architecture of Zuora solutions. The position requires strong consulting skills with the ability to effectively command a room. The solution architect plays a lead role during the implementation, identifying and documenting client business requirements, mapping and configuring the Zuora solution to meet the client’s requirements and providing guidance to the client to achieve a successful implementation. They must identify potential issues and risks early in an implementation to develop mitigation strategies and contingency plans. A solid candidate will have an innate ability to simplify complex technology concepts and to plan, prioritize and seamlessly integrate all moving parts to deploy successful solutions.
   

  

 This is a remote position, so you’ll be working remotely while occasionally getting together with your team for office visits, events, or offsites. Of course, you’re welcome to come into the office more often if you’re nearby.
   

  

**What You’ll Achieve**
* Solution design using the full Zuora product portfolio
* Design and validate that the proposed solution architecture supports the stated and implied business requirements
* Review technical team deliverables for compliance with architecture standards, guidelines and leverages best practices
* Articulate and present different point of views on various technologies
* Present Architecture deliverables such as Ecosystem and Integration diagrams, ERD, Business Process Flows, Swim lanes, Visio and Mock\-ups
* Exhibit strong executive presence and ability to interact and effectively communicate with key project sponsors from CXO to end users.
* Deliver Expert Services to the Zuora Partners


**About You**
* Must have enterprise level experience, within a professional services organisation, as a Solution Architect and/or Business Consultant with a leading technology consulting or product company, delivering moderate to complex ERP, billing, revenue, procurement and/or CRM solutions.
* Demonstrated leadership abilities to lead business discussions with customers and architect the value of our solution and the best practices to implement it
* Experience in requirements gathering, use cases documentation, business analysis, systems design and integration, user interface design and implementation
* Experience in data analysis, conversion and migration, interfaces and reports
* Experience with system design using configuration and/or customization, integration, testing and support
* Experience in delivering end to end solutions through the entire SDLC \- right from running the client facing workshops, design, build, test, deployment, UAT and handover
* Experience in Waterfall and Agile methodologies
* Must be a strong team player with excellent communication skills at the business and technical level, able to collaborate as part of a diverse and distributed team to deliver exceptional customer results in a rapid paced implementation environment
* Experience with accounting and be able to converse effectively with Finance teams
* Experience managing tasks on multiple projects simultaneously


**Benefits**
 Zuora offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support ZEOs’ wellbeing, growth, and flexibility. While specific offerings may vary by country, we typically provide:
   

  

* Competitive compensation, variable bonus and performance\-based reward opportunities, and retirement programs
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Generous, flexible time off, plus paid holidays, wellness days, and a company\-wide year\-end break
* Paid parental leave (including fully paid leave for eligible ZEOs, subject to local policy)
* Learning \& development stipend to support ongoing growth
* Opportunities to volunteer and give back, including charitable donation matching where available
* Mental wellbeing resources and support
* Benefits may vary by location; details will be shared during the interview process


 \#ZEOLife at Zuora
   

  

 ZEOs (our employees) are empowered to take ownership, challenge the status quo, and make a real impact. We:
   

  

* Collaborate deeply across teams and regions
* Learn constantly and iterate often
* Build an inclusive, high\-performance culture where people feel inspired, connected, and valued


 Our Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace
   

  

 Think, be and do you.
   

  

 At Zuora, different perspectives, experiences, and contributions matter — everyone counts.
   

  

 Zuora is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of, and consider individuals seeking employment with Zuora without regard to, race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
   

  

 We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us by sending an email to
 **assistance@zuora.com** 
 (or local equivalent, where applicable).

5ef4358d.title: Sr. Solution Consultant, Enterprise Scheduling
5ef4358d.description:
**About Kinaxis**
 Elevate your career journey by embracing a new challenge with Kinaxis. We are experts in tech, but it’s really our people who give us passion to always seek ways to do things better. As such, we’re serious about your career growth and professional development, because People matter at Kinaxis.
   

  

 In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers based in Ottawa, Canada. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, and support 40,000\+ users in over 100 countries. As a global leader in end\-to\-end supply chain management, we enable supply chain excellence for all industries. We are expanding our team in Chennai and around the world as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.
   

  

 Our journey in India began in 2020 and we have been growing steadily since then! Building a high\-trust and high\-performance culture is important to us and we are proud to be Great Place to Work® Certified TM . Our state\-of\-the\-art office, located in the World Trade Centre in Chennai, offers our growing team space for expansion and collaboration.
   

  

**Location**
 Chennai, India
   

  

**About The Team**
 As a member of our Consulting Team, you understand our customers’ most pressing business performance challenges and you are committed to helping our customers solve complex challenges in the distributed value chain that is prevalent in manufacturing today.
   

  

****What you will do****
* Participate in in the end\-to\-end deployment of production scheduling tool including deep\-dive customer business requirements discovery sessions and develop requirements specifications documentation.
* Collaborates closely with agile team members to support the configuration, implementation of Maestro software to enable the solution according to our customers distinct needs
* Translate business requirements into Kinaxis Maestro software specifications, following supply chain industry trends and best practices.
* Support senior team members in providing creative solutions to complex business problems while maintaining best practices.
* Participate in data management and data integration activities, including source systems data transformation, data loading, data cleanup and validation.
* Perform training of customer end users on the configured solution.
* Provide technical support to end users and resolve issues of the configured solutions, escalating to senior team members as needed.
* Support the validation and testing of the solution and capture user feedback.
* Actively engage, guide and mentor to develop the skills of junior consultants on projects.
* Any other reasonable project related tasks as assigned by the Project Manager.


****What we are looking for****
* Candidates with results\-oriented mindset, focusing on improving client satisfaction and providing a very high standard of service, driving towards Kinaxis’s success.
* Sound knowledge in Supply Chain concepts especially scheduling with 6\+ years of experience.
* Strong intent to learn our first in class product “Maestro”
* Work in a fast\-paced project environment and co\-ordinate with members at all levels in an organization
* Highly adaptable professional, able to embrace teamwork in diverse and evolving work environments.
* Capability to lead by example, having the drive to think in an innovative way and have passion about new challenges
* Ability to solve complex problems, think critically and make sound judgement decisions.
* A passion for working in customer facing roles that require high level of interpersonal, communication, facilitation and presentation skills.
* Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively in English, both verbally and in writing
* Technical skills such as SQL, R, Java Script, Python, etc.
* Experience with manufacturing planning solutions such as Kinaxis, SAP, JDA, etc. is an added advantage


 \#Senior
   

  

**Work With Impact:** 
 Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day—when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.
   

  

**Work with Fortune 500 Brands:** 
 Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Ford, Unilever, Yamaha, P\&G, Lockheed\-Martin, and more.
   

  

**Social Responsibility at Kinaxis:** 
 Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to net\-zero operations strategy for the long term. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.
   

  

 People matter at Kinaxis and these are some of the perks and benefits we created for our team:
   

  

* Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company\-wide day off on the last Friday of every month)
* Flexible work options
* Physical and mental well\-being programs
* Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
* Mentorship programs and training and career development
* Recognition programs and referral rewards
* Hackathons


 For more information, visit the Kinaxis web site at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com .
   

  

 Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. Please note that this contact information is strictly for accessibility requests and cannot be used to inquire about application statuses.
   

  

 Kinaxis is committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the initial step of the recruitment process to compare submitted resumes against the job description, to identify candidates whose education, experience and skills most closely match the requirements of the role. After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

afa57880.title: Technical Architect
afa57880.description:
Introduction
   

  

**Job Title:** 
 Technical Architect
   

  

**About SymphonyAI Retail:**
 SymphonyAI Retail is a leading provider of advanced AI\-driven solutions and services specifically designed for the retail industry. We empower retailers and consumer packaged goods (CPG) companies with innovative technology to enhance their operations, optimize decision\-making, and deliver exceptional customer experiences. SymphonyAI Retail is a global leader in the supply of integrated business solutions to organizations worldwide, serving 30 of the top 50 global grocery retailers and numerous consumer brands.
   

  

**Overview:**
 We are seeking a highly experienced Technical Architect for the SCM GOLD platform to lead the design and delivery of complex retail supply chain implementations. This role requires deep expertise across both functional supply chain processes and technical architecture, with the ability to translate business requirements into scalable solution designs. The Architect will work closely with clients, Professional Services, R\&D, and partner teams to ensure successful implementation, integration, and deployment of SCM GOLD solutions across large\-scale retail environments. This role is critical for high\-visibility programs and will provide architectural leadership from solution design through implementation, UAT, and production cutover.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Solution Architecture \& Design:**
* Lead end\-to\-end solution architecture for SCM GOLD implementations, ensuring alignment with client business goals and SymphonyAI product capabilities.
* Translate complex retail supply chain requirements into scalable functional and technical solution designs.
* Define system architecture, integration frameworks, and configuration strategy across SCM GOLD modules.
* Guide design decisions across forecasting, replenishment, inventory optimization, and supply chain planning capabilities.


**Technical Leadership:**
* Provide hands\-on architectural guidance for system configuration, customization, integrations, and performance optimization.
* Partner closely with R\&D teams to ensure product capabilities align with client requirements and implementation strategy.
* Support technical teams in resolving complex implementation challenges and architectural trade\-offs.
* Ensure best practices across data architecture, APIs, and system integrations.


**Client and Stakeholder Engagement:**
* Lead technical and functional discussions with client executives, program leaders, and technical teams.
* Act as the primary architecture authority during design workshops, solution reviews, and executive checkpoints.
* Provide architectural guidance during UAT, testing cycles, and production deployment.
* Support client change management and adoption of SCM GOLD capabilities.


**Program Delivery Support:**
* Collaborate with Professional Services, Partner Delivery teams, and Implementation Leads to ensure solution integrity throughout the program lifecycle.
* Provide oversight during key delivery phases including design validation, system build, UAT readiness, and production cutover.
* Support risk mitigation and architectural governance for complex implementations.


**Technical Skills:**
* Hands\-on experience in:
+ Solid understanding of System Design \& Architecture and Integration.
+ Solid understanding of Java (core Java).
+ Solid understanding of REST APIs.
+ Solid understanding of database concepts (preferably Oracle), SQL, and PL/SQL.
+ Solid understanding of Shell scripting.
+ Fair understanding of JavaScript/HTML/CSS\-based applications implementation.
+ Basic understanding of Vue/React\-based applications implementation.


**Other Experience:**
* 10\+ years of experience in retail supply chain technology implementations.
* Deep expertise in SymphonyAI SCM GOLD platform (technical and functional) is a plus but not essential.
* Proven experience designing and delivering large\-scale supply chain planning solutions.
* Strong understanding of retail planning, forecasting, replenishment, and inventory optimization processes.
* Experience working across solution architecture, system integration, and enterprise deployment.
* Ability to lead complex client\-facing discussions with both business and technical stakeholders.
* Experience collaborating with product teams, delivery teams, and global partners.
* Good understanding of cloud platforms.


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Experience delivering large enterprise retail transformation programs.
* Strong background in supply chain data architecture and system integration.
* Experience supporting UAT, testing governance, and deployment strategies.
* Ability to mentor implementation teams and guide architectural best practices.


**Diversity \& Inclusion Statement:**
 We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.
   

  

**About Us**
 SymphonyAI is building the leading enterprise AI SaaS company for digital transformation across the most critical and resilient growth industries, including retail, consumer packaged goods, financial crime prevention, manufacturing, media, and enterprise IT. Since its founding in 2017, SymphonyAI has grown to today serve 2000\+ Enterprise customers globally and has grown to 2,500 talented leaders, data scientists, and other professionals across over 30 countries.

3c284d47.title: Software Architect Platform Services
3c284d47.description:
TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology—enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization.
   

  

 We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 We are looking for a Software Architect Platform Services to play a key role in shaping the software architecture of our remote access, control, and support solutions. In this highly collaborative role, you will work closely with cross\-functional teams to design and evolve our software architecture using the latest technologies and best practices. This is an exciting opportunity to drive innovation, make a tangible impact, and contribute to a culture that values engineering excellence, agility, and teamwork.
   

  

* Conceptualize and design platform\-independent, scalable, secure, reliable and high\-performing cloud / SaaS solutions
* Develop guidelines and best practices around architecture which will be relevant for the whole organization
* Contribute to solution designs incorporating AI capabilities, intelligent services, and automation, with an understanding of how AI frameworks can be effectively integrated into software architectures to increase business value.
* Provide technical leadership, coaching, guidance and support our platform development teams when it comes to any architectural topic
* Conduct technical assessments and proof of concepts, and evaluate design and implementation approaches
* Create and maintain comprehensive and accurate documentation of architectural designs, processes, decisions and best practices
* Keep up to date with the latest technological trends and advances in software architecture, cloud computing and related areas and initiate improvements based on them


**Requirements**
* University or college degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Software Engineering, or any related subject
* 9\+ years of professional experience in the field of object\-oriented software development using C\+\+ or .NET (C\# in particular) combined with extensive knowledge around SQL and NoSQL databases such as MS SQL, Cassandra or Scylla
* Proficient knowledge and experience in the following areas: architectural and coding design patterns; distributed, high\-available and scalable systems; service\-oriented architecture (i.e. microservices) and containerization (e.g. Kubernetes)
