0f80d4c5.title: Program Manager
0f80d4c5.description:
**Job Description \- Program Manager – Karnataka** 




**Location:** 
 Bengaluru, Karnataka
 



**Engagement:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Experience:** 
 5–7 years
 



**Reporting To:** 
 State Lead – Karnataka
 



  





**About the Role** 




 STEP Foundation is seeking a driven, execution\-oriented Program Manager to support its work in Karnataka. The Program Manager will work closely with the State Lead to support engagement with the Government of Karnataka, Invest Karnataka, Karnataka Udyog Mitra, relevant government departments, industry bodies, and other ecosystem stakeholders.
 



 The role will be responsible for translating the State Lead's strategic priorities and stakeholder engagements into effective day\-to\-day execution. This will include coordinating with government and industry stakeholders, driving follow\-ups, tracking programme activities, supporting meetings and consultations, preparing programme materials, and ensuring timely execution of agreed actions.
 



 The Program Manager will play an important role in strengthening the Foundation's engagement with the government ecosystem and ensuring that relationships and opportunities developed by the State Lead translate into tangible programme outcomes.
 



 The ideal candidate will bring
 **5–7 years of professional experience** 
 , with meaningful exposure to government, public institutions, development organisations, consulting, public policy, skills, employment, or related programmes. They should have a good understanding of how government systems function and be comfortable working across multiple stakeholders and institutions.
 



 This is a hands\-on role for someone who is organised, proactive and comfortable taking ownership of execution. The candidate should be able to work independently on day\-to\-day responsibilities while closely aligning with the State Lead on priorities, stakeholder engagement and programme direction.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Government Stakeholder Coordination** 



* Support the State Lead in managing relationships with government departments, agencies, boards and institutions across Karnataka.
* Participate in meetings with government officials and support the State Lead in ensuring that discussions translate into clear next steps.
* Maintain regular communication with relevant government stakeholders and ensure timely follow\-through on agreed actions.
* Develop a working understanding of government processes, hierarchies and institutional structures relevant to programme implementation.
* Support coordination across departments and institutions wherever required. Track government priorities, announcements, programmes and developments relevant to the Foundation's work.



**2\. Programme Execution \& Coordination** 



* Drive day\-to\-day execution of state\-level programmes and initiatives under the direction of the State Lead.
* Translate strategic priorities and programme plans into clear action items, timelines and deliverables.
* Follow up with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely completion of agreed activities.
* Identify execution bottlenecks and proactively escalate issues to the State Lead. Support implementation of pilots, partnerships and institutional initiatives across the state.



**3\. Stakeholder Engagement \& Follow\-through** 



* Support the State Lead in building and maintaining relationships with government, industry, development organisations, academia and other ecosystem stakeholders. Coordinate stakeholder meetings, workshops, consultations and roundtables. Prepare agendas, briefing materials, discussion notes and follow\-up trackers for stakeholder engagements.
* Build strong working relationships with mid\- and senior\-level stakeholders across the ecosystem.
* Serve as a consistent point of contact for day\-to\-day programme coordination with relevant stakeholders.



**4\. Industry \& Ecosystem Engagement** 



* Support engagement with companies, industry associations, investors, business leaders and other private\-sector stakeholders.
* Coordinate with industry stakeholders to understand workforce, investment, talent and ecosystem requirements.
* Support the conversion of stakeholder discussions into actionable partnerships, pilots and programme activities.



**5\. Programme Development \& Implementation** 



* Support the State Lead in translating government and industry priorities into actionable programme opportunities.
* Support the development of concept notes, proposals, presentations, briefing notes and programme documents.
* Coordinate internal teams to develop high\-quality programme outputs.
* Support the design and implementation of state\-level initiatives in consultation with government and industry stakeholders.
* Track programme performance and prepare regular updates for the State Lead and leadership team.



**6\. Reporting, Tracking \& Internal Coordination** 



* Maintain programme trackers covering key activities, milestones, stakeholders, meetings and deliverables.
* Prepare regular status updates for the State Lead on programme progress, stakeholder engagement and emerging issues.
* Coordinate across internal teams to ensure alignment on priorities and deliverables. Support preparation of internal reviews, presentations and leadership updates.



**7\. Supporting State\-Level Representation** 



* Represent STEP Foundation in relevant programme\-level meetings, consultations, workshops and stakeholder engagements, as required.
* Support the State Lead in preparing for high\-level government and industry meetings.
* Communicate programme\-related information clearly and professionally to government, industry and development\-sector stakeholders.
* Build credibility and trust with stakeholders through consistent engagement and strong execution.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




 The ideal candidate will be a
 **highly organised, proactive and execution\-oriented professional** 
 who is comfortable working with government and multiple stakeholders. They should be able to understand the larger strategic objective while being equally comfortable managing the detailed, day\-to\-day work required to deliver programmes effectively.
 



  





**Essential Experience** 



* **5–7 years of professional experience** 
 , with experience working with government, public institutions, development organisations, consulting firms, public policy organisations, or government\-facing programmes.
* Prior experience working directly with or alongside government institutions will be strongly preferred.
* Experience in programme management, project management, stakeholder coordination or implementation\-oriented roles.
* Experience working in a complex, multi\-stakeholder environment.
* Experience coordinating multiple workstreams, stakeholders and deliverables simultaneously.
* Experience preparing presentations, briefing notes, concept notes, reports and other professional programme documentation.
* Experience in areas such as skills, employment, economic development, public policy, industry engagement or government programmes will be an advantage.



  





**Core Competencies** 



* Strong programme and project management skills.
* Strong stakeholder coordination and follow\-through.
* Good understanding of how government departments, agencies and institutions function.
* Ability to navigate government processes and institutional structures. Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver within timelines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to build productive working relationships. Ability to work effectively with government officials, industry stakeholders and development\-sector professionals.
* Ability to work independently while taking direction and strategic guidance from the State Lead.



  





**Strong proficiency in Kannada is mandatory.** 




 Excellent proficiency in English required.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 Master's degree in public policy, economics, management, engineering, social sciences, development studies, or a related discipline.
 



  





**Preferred Backgrounds** 



* Candidates with experience in 1 or more of the following environments will be particularly well suited:
* Government departments / state government institutions
* Development organisations and foundations
* Public policy organisations
* Organisations working at the intersection of government, industry, skills, employment and economic development
* Organisations working on large\-scale government or public\-sector initiatives



  





**Working Style** 




 The role requires someone who:
 


* Is highly organised, proactive and execution\-oriented.
* Is comfortable working closely with government stakeholders and within government systems.
* Can take ownership of day\-to\-day programme execution while working under the strategic direction of the State Lead.
* Is persistent and resourceful in navigating institutional processes.
* Can manage multiple stakeholders, workstreams and deadlines simultaneously. Is comfortable with ambiguity and can independently solve day\-to\-day execution challenges.
* Is able to move between government meetings, programme implementation, stakeholder coordination and internal team discussions.



  





**Location \& Travel** 




**Base Location:** 
 Bengaluru, Karnataka
 



 The role will require travel within Karnataka and regular in\-person engagement with government departments, government agencies, industry stakeholders and other ecosystem partners.

**We help the world run better**
 At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Solution Account Lead (SAL) is a strategic leader who combines deep SAP expertise, business acumen, and end\-to\-end solution area domain knowledge to drive LoB cloud revenue, customer success, accelerate adoption of innovation (especially AI), and position the organization as a market leader. The SAL shapes transformative solutions and delivers measurable value to customers through thought leadership, innovation, and strategic execution—supporting both specific Lines of Business (LoB) and the overall “One SAP” strategy.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Account Ownership \& Strategy:** 
 Serve as the LoB owner for assigned accounts, developing and executing strategic account plans that align with customer goals, business objectives and broader account plans by account team.
   

  

**Drive End\-to\-End Customer Value Journey with Domain Expertise:** 
 Provide solution area domain expertise and thought leadership to understand and address high\-priority business challenges. Lead end\-to\-end process mapping and the customer value journey, owning the transformation roadmap for the LoB.
   

  

**Pipeline \& Opportunity Management:** 
 Identify and develop new business opportunities within existing accounts, contributing to pipeline growth and revenue targets.
   

  

**Product Success \& Innovation:** 
 Drive go\-to\-market for new products, engage early with customers, validate solutions, and influence the product roadmap. Lead AI and innovation initiatives (e.g., BDC, Knowledge Graphs, scalable PoCs, Joule agents).
   

  

**Enablement, Demos \& Prototypes:** 
 Support solution advisors to ensure demo system readiness and manage enablement programs. Collaborate with Demo \& Learning teams to provide updated assets and trial environments as part of scalable enablement programs as well as customized demos, POCs and prototypes with customer specific data.
   

  

**Value Proposition \& Executive Engagement:** 
 Collaborate with value advisors to create compelling narratives articulating ROI, value leakage and competitive advantages. Conduct strategic discovery, run value leakage, AOTP workshops and deliver persuasive pitches with ways of solving distinct customer business/buying\-center challenges to accelerate executive buy\-in and drive demand independently of RFPs.
   

  

**Commercial Negotiations:** 
 Navigate complex pricing and contractual discussions, balancing client expectations with organizational profitability and cloud revenue growth.
   

  

**Adoption \& Consumption:** 
 Support Customer Success Management (CSM) communities, secure references, and manage escalations. Collaborate with CS and CS\&D adoption teams to ensure successful delivery of solutions and services, monitoring outcomes and driving continuous improvement to maximize customer value.
   

  

**Customer Success \& Field Impact:** 
 Own LoB deal cycles, renewals, enablement, and executive engagement. Elevate customer discussions to prioritize investment and drive measurable outcomes.
   

  

**Relationship Building \& Governance:** 
 Drive C\-suite engagements and Buying Center Alignment by fostering long\-term high\-value relationships and convert executives into advocates and brand ambassadors. Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with customers and internal stakeholders focused on solution adoption, innovation, risks and opportunities.
   

  

**Ecosystem \& Partner Engagement:** 
 Own relationships with strategic consulting partners (e.g., McKinsey, Bain, Accenture, Deloitte, PwC, EY) to co\-innovate, develop joint go\-to\-market strategies, and shape disruptive solutions. Maintain direct, high\-quality relationships with partner account leads.
   

  

**Collaboration \& Orchestration:** 
 Align closely with Sales, Product, and Marketing to ensure SAL impact is fully integrated into the go\-to\-market engine with tailored GTM approach. Drive joint accountability and coordination across internal stakeholders for maximum market impact.
   

  

**Competitive \& Industry Expertise:** 
 Maintain deep technical and functional knowledge across SAP solutions. Stay at the forefront of emerging technologies and competitive trends to craft differentiated solutions that win in the market.
   

  

**Qualifications \& Competencies**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Information Technology, or related field.
* Management consulting type profile with 10\-15 Years Industry or Practitioner experience; Executive relationship building skills with proven C\-suite influence.
* B2B enterprise experience with multi\-stakeholder SaaS cycles, plus top\-tier consulting and deep industry expertise.
* Proven experience in account management, solution sales, or customer success roles.
* Strong understanding of solution sales, customer value realization, and account planning methodologies; Expansion selling track record (account growth).
* Deep SAP and domain expertise, with strong understanding of AI and innovation trends.
* Maps value levers and tell a quantified ROI storytelling and compelling business case creation
* Strategic thinking, business acumen, relationship building and client advocacy skills.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management abilities.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a matrixed environment and influence without direct authority.
* Analytical mindset with a focus on problem\-solving and continuous improvement.
* 12 plus years’ experience in a quota carrying role
* 5 plus years’ domain experience in Finance \& Spend Management (Procurement / oCFO solutions) domain either from related industry or consulting
* Drive pipeline and deal execution for SAP oCFO solutions in collaboration with account teams.
* Support value\-based discovery and executive conversations with CFO and finance leadership.
* Position SAP oCFO solutions with clear differentiation and business outcomes.
* Act as the oCFO domain specialist supporting sales teams and partners. Execute joint GTM motions with regional, global, and partner teams.
* Proven solution sales / pre\-sales experience in complex enterprise deals.


**Why This Role Matters**
 The SAL is pivotal in shaping SAP’s market leadership by delivering transformative solutions, driving innovation (especially in AI), and orchestrating value across the customer lifecycle. This role is at the intersection of strategy, technology, and relationship management, ensuring customers realize the full value of their SAP investments while positioning the organization for sustained growth.
   

  

 \#SSET4

**Bring out your best**
 SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end\-to\-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose\-driven and future\-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.
   

  

**We win with inclusion**
 SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well\-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential.  We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
**Your Key Responsibilities**
* 10\+ years of experience in respective domain.
* Solution Architecture
* Lead end\-to\-end solutioning activities for SAP transformation opportunities, including RFPs, RFIs, and proposal responses.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, account teams, and subject matter experts to define winning SAP solution strategies aligned with client requirements
* Lead end\-to\-end SAP solution architecture across core SAP S/4HANA business processes and cross\-workstream integration points.
* Translate business requirements and process designs into scalable SAP architecture, including fit\-to\-standard, extension, integration, reporting, security, and data considerations.
* Provide architecture oversight for SAP modules such as Finance, Supply Chain, Sales, Procurement, Manufacturing, Plant Maintenance, Quality, Warehouse, Transportation, and HR interfaces, as applicable to the program scope.
* Define and govern solution principles, architectural guardrails, design decisions, and key integration patterns across SAP and non\-SAP systems.
* Review functional and technical solution documents to ensure design completeness, consistency, and alignment with SAP best practices.


**Delivery Governance \& Program Leadership**
* Support full lifecycle SAP program delivery from discovery, design and build through testing, cutover, deployment, hypercare, and stabilization.
* Drive architecture governance forums, solution review boards, design workshops, risk reviews, and key decision\-making discussions.
* Partner with project managers, workstream leads, technical leads, and client stakeholders to manage scope, dependencies, delivery plans, risks, issues, and quality gates.
* Identify cross\-functional gaps early and coordinate resolution across business process, application, integration, data, security, infrastructure, and change teams.
* Prepare leadership\-ready architecture updates, decision papers, options analysis, and steering committee inputs.


**Integration, Data \& Technical Oversight**
* Provide oversight for SAP integration architecture using SAP BTP, CPI, PI/PO, APIs, IDocs, RFCs, event\-driven patterns, middleware, and third\-party platforms.
* Collaborate with data migration teams on data strategy, conversion design, mock migration planning, reconciliation, validation, cutover sequencing, and defect resolution.
* Assess custom developments, enhancements, RICEFW objects, forms, workflows, reports, and extensions to ensure maintainability and clean\-core alignment.
* Guide technical teams on architecture fitment across SAP S/4HANA, SAP RISE, BTP services, cloud integrations, analytics, identity, authorization, and infrastructure dependencies.


**Quality Assurance \& Continuous Improvement**
* Ensure adherence to SAP Activate, fit\-to\-standard principles, agile delivery practices, documentation standards, and program quality gates.
* Conduct solution walkthroughs, design validations, test readiness reviews, cutover readiness checkpoints, and post\-go\-live stabilization reviews.
* Promote reusable assets, templates, accelerators, architectural playbooks, and delivery improvements across the SAP Architecture Team.
* Drive proactive risk identification and mitigation planning across architecture, integration, data migration, performance, security, and operational readiness.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Core SAP \& Transformation Expertise**
* Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA architecture, SAP Activate methodology, enterprise process integration, and large transformation delivery models.
* Broad knowledge of SAP functional domains and cross\-module integration across finance, procurement, supply chain, manufacturing, logistics, maintenance, quality, sales, and related business areas.
* Ability to evaluate business requirements, solution options, SAP standard capabilities, custom extension needs, integration requirements, and downstream operational implications.
* Experience with ECC to SAP S/4HANA transformation, brownfield, greenfield, selective data transition, or hybrid delivery approaches.


**Technical Architecture Skills**
* Working knowledge of SAP BTP, CPI, PI/PO, APIs, IDocs, CDS views, Fiori, roles and authorizations, analytics, workflow, and cloud integration principles.
* Understanding of SAP RISE, hyperscaler environments, network/security dependencies, transport strategy, landscape planning, and operational readiness.
* Experience reviewing RICEFW scope, custom code remediation, simplification items, integration inventory, interface rationalization, and technical debt reduction.
* Knowledge of data migration strategy, master data governance, reconciliation, validation, migration cockpit, ETL tools, and cutover execution.


**Leadership \& Consulting Skills**
* Strong stakeholder management with the ability to engage business leaders, IT leadership, global process owners, vendors, and delivery teams.
* Ability to simplify complex SAP concepts into clear, actionable messages for leadership and project teams.
* Proven ability to lead distributed teams, manage ambiguity, resolve conflicts, and drive decisions in complex transformation environments.
* Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, problem\-solving, decision\-making, and risk management skills.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture** 
 : In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Job description:
   

  

 Job Description
 
 Role Purpose
 



 The purpose of this role is to design solution architecture for cross\-system interactions and business logic integration, ensuring seamless interoperability across multiple applications.
 


 ͏
 
 Area of Responsibility
 



 Requirement Analysis\-Participate in requirement discussions with client stakeholders to define solution and implementation level needs basis the business requirements.
 



 Designing\-Create solution architecture designs to meet cross\-system interactions and business logic integration requirements, ensuring system cohesion across multiple applications.
 



 Integration assessment and support\-Assess and evaluate interactions across multiple applications by evaluating implementation dependencies and integration requirements.
 



 Troubleshooting\-Support validation of solution components during implementation and ensures the solution functions as designed.
 



 Risk Analysis and Assessment\-Assist in identifying potential risks by evaluating system performance of implemented architectural solutions, to ensure efficient system landscape.
 


 ͏ ͏ ͏
 
**Role Overview:**
 The Automation Solution Architect is responsible for evaluating existing business processes, identifying automation opportunities, and designing scalable, secure, and efficient automation solutions. This role involves selecting the appropriate technology stack, providing technical leadership to development teams, and overseeing the entire automation lifecycle from design to deployment and ongoing support. 
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 



* **Strategy \& Planning:** 
  Collaborate with business analysts and stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into technical specifications for automation solutions.
* **Architecture Design:** 
  Design the technical architecture and blueprint for automation projects, making decisions on technology stacks, integration methods (e.g., APIs, databases), and overall system design.
* **Standards \& Governance:** 
  Define and enforce enterprise\-wide standards, best practices, and governance policies for automation development, documentation, and testing to ensure consistency and compliance.
* **Technology Selection:** 
  Research, evaluate, and recommend appropriate automation tools, platforms (e.g., UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Azure Logic Apps), and technologies that align with the organization's budget and technical environment.
* **Oversight \& Guidance:** 
  Oversee the development, testing, deployment, and monitoring stages of automation projects, providing expert guidance and mentorship to developers.
* **Quality Assurance:** 
  Lead code and design reviews to ensure quality, reusability, and adherence to security and performance standards.
* **Continuous Improvement:** 
  Monitor the performance of automated processes, troubleshoot issues, and identify opportunities for optimization and improvement using analytics and feedback.
* **Documentation:** 
  Create and maintain comprehensive architectural documentation, including Solution Design Documents (SDD), flowcharts, and system diagrams.
* **Required Skills and Qualifications:** 



	+ **Experience:**
	+ Proven experience of at least 3\-4 years as a Solution Architect or similar role, with specific experience in designing and implementing enterprise\-level automation solutions.
	+ Hands\-on experience with automation tools (e.g., UiPath, Blue Prism, Automation Anywhere) and DevOps tooling (e.g., Jenkins, Git, Ansible) is often required.
	+ **Technical Knowledge:**
	+ Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies (Agile, Waterfall).
	+ Proficiency in programming or scripting languages such as Python, C\#, VB.NET, or Java.
	+ Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization technologies is a strong plus.
	+ Expertise in database design, API integrations, and security principles.



  
 



 Mandatory Skills: Infrastructure Automation
   

 .
 



  
 



 Experience: 8\-10 Years
   

 .

 You will work at the intersection of business requirements, Oracle product expertise, and industry best practices to create scalable and effective solutions.
   

  

 Your scope will cover project financial management, costing, billing, contracts, budgeting, revenue recognition, and project control.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with client stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into robust system configurations.
   

  

 The role combines functional leadership, solution design, testing, documentation, and client engagement across the full implementation lifecycle.
   

  

 You will also help organizations improve visibility into project performance and streamline critical financial and operational processes.
   

  

 This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Oracle PPM professional to take ownership of high\-impact transformation initiatives in a client\-facing environment
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Lead end\-to\-end implementations of Oracle Cloud PPM, covering Project Financial Management, Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Contracts, and Project Control, while ensuring solutions align with client objectives and industry best practices.
* Partner with client stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements and translate them into effective Oracle Cloud configurations.
* Configure project structures, task setups, budgeting methods, costing methods, billing rules, revenue recognition processes, and related project financial functionalities.
* Design solutions that enable accurate capture and management of project costs and revenues while supporting efficient billing and revenue recognition cycles.
* Implement and optimize solutions for capital project tracking, project budgeting, forecasting, and contract\-based billing.
* Ensure seamless data flows across Oracle PPM and related modules to support accurate project tracking, financial visibility, and reporting.
* Lead Conference Room Pilot (CRP) sessions and validate end\-to\-end project processes to ensure functional accuracy and alignment with business requirements.
* Conduct testing and validation activities, ensuring solutions comply with business rules, accounting standards, internal controls, and audit requirements.
* Support fit\-gap analysis, configuration, testing, training, deployment, and go\-live activities throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Produce high\-quality functional design documents, configuration documentation, test scenarios, process documentation, and user guides.
* Advise clients on Oracle Cloud PPM best practices, solution enhancements, and opportunities to maximize the value of their investment.
* Stay current with Oracle Cloud PPM releases, features, and capabilities and identify relevant opportunities for improvement.
* Collaborate effectively with onshore and offshore functional and technical teams to coordinate delivery and resolve implementation challenges.


**Requirements**

* Demonstrate deep functional knowledge of Oracle Cloud PPM, particularly Project Financial Management, Project Costing, Project Billing, and Project Contracts.

* Familiarity with Oracle reporting and analytics tools such as OTBI, BI Publisher, and Smart View is preferred.
* Oracle Cloud PPM certification is an advantage.
* Experience working with Oracle Cloud release 21 or later is preferred.
* Demonstrate strong analytical, problem\-solving, organization, and client\-facing skills, with the ability to balance business priorities and technical considerations.


**Benefits**
* Opportunity to lead high\-impact Oracle Cloud PPM transformation and implementation initiatives.
* Broad exposure to project financial management, costing, billing, contracts, budgeting, and reporting processes.
* Client\-facing role with significant interaction with business stakeholders and cross\-functional implementation teams.
* Opportunity to work across distributed onshore and offshore teams in an international delivery environment.
* Exposure to Oracle Cloud Financials, Procurement, HCM, and reporting technologies through integrated solutions.

7ba489f3.title: Delivery Lead - Social & Search Ops
7ba489f3.description:
* **Title** 
 : Delivery Lead — Social \& Search Ops
* **Location** 
 : Bengaluru, India (Work from Office, 5 days a week)
* **Timings** 
 : 2\-11 pm



  





**About Joveo** 




 As the global leader in AI\-powered recruitment marketing, we are transforming talent attraction and recruitment media buying for the world’s largest and smartest employers, staffing businesses, RPOs, and recruitment advertising agencies.
 



  





 The Joveo platform enables businesses to attract, source, engage, and hire the most relevant candidates on time, within their budget. Powering millions of jobs every day, our data\-driven recruitment marketing platform uses advanced data science and machine learning to dynamically manage and optimize talent sourcing and applications across all online channels while providing real\-time insights at every step of the job seeker journey, from click to hire.
 



  





**About the Role** 



* The Delivery Lead is the most senior role in the Social \& Search Operations team. You own the business — revenue, client outcomes, team performance, and the operating model that ties it all together.
* The team is structured in pods. Each pod is an Account Manager and one or more Associates. The AM owns the client relationship within their pod; the Associate owns campaign execution. You sit above all pods — accountable for what every pod delivers, for the commercial health of the client portfolio, and for the team's growth as professionals.
* This role exists because the team is scaling a significant mandate: taking over client\-facing campaign operations from a CS function, building toward full end\-to\-end ownership of enterprise recruitment advertising accounts. You will be the person who makes that transition work — credible with clients, trusted by your team, and commercially sharp with leadership.
* If you have spent your career executing campaigns for someone else's clients, this is not the right step. If you have owned outcomes — revenue targets, client retention, team results — and are ready to do that in a high\-growth environment, this is the role.



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Own the revenue number for the Social \& Search Operations practice — renewals, upsells, and new business contributions
* Oversee all client pods — review account health across the portfolio, identify risk accounts, and intervene when needed
* Step in as the senior escalation point for client issues that exceed AM\-level resolution
* Present portfolio\-level performance and strategy to senior client stakeholders (C\-suite, VP\-level) on key accounts
* Lead quarterly business reviews for strategic accounts alongside or on behalf of AMs
* Partner with Sales on enterprise pitches and proposals — you bring the performance marketing credibility
* Hire, onboard, and develop AMs and Associates — including defining role clarity, setting performance expectations, and running structured feedback
* Define and enforce operating standards across pods: SLA compliance, reporting quality, campaign health benchmarks
* Work with leadership to define which accounts receive full client\-facing ownership vs. CS\-supported delivery
* Report monthly to senior leadership on capacity utilisation, revenue performance, and team health



  





**What You Will Own** 



* The revenue performance of the Social \& Search Operations practice
* Client retention across all pod accounts — renewal rate, satisfaction, escalation resolution
* Team structure and headcount decisions — you define when a new pod is needed and what profile to hire
* Cross\-pod quality and consistency — every client gets the same standard regardless of which pod they sit in
* The operating model — you update and enforce the RoE, SLAs, and pod protocols as the team evolves



  





**What You Bring** 



* 7–12 years in performance marketing, with the last 3\+ years in a leadership role that included direct revenue or P\&L accountability
* Proven track record of owning client relationships at a senior level — you have presented to and retained enterprise clients, not just supported someone who did
* Direct team management experience — you have hired, developed, and if necessary, exited people
* Deep hands\-on knowledge of paid media (Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn, programmatic) — you can review a campaign setup and identify problems, even if you no longer run accounts yourself
* Commercial acumen — you understand margin, renewal economics, upsell signals, and how to have a pricing or scope conversation with a client
* Experience running operations at scale — multiple clients, multiple channels, multiple team members simultaneously
* Strong executive communication — you are credible in a C\-suite room, and you can translate campaign performance into business outcomes without losing the audience
* Bangalore\-based or willing to relocate — this is a full\-time, in\-office leadership role



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Background in performance marketing agencies — multi\-client ops and client servicing discipline is a strong advantage
* Experience in recruitment advertising, employer branding, or HR tech — shortest ramp time into Joveo's client context
* P\&L ownership or revenue target accountability in a previous role — not just budget management
* Experience building or restructuring a team from the ground up
* Exposure to programmatic advertising platforms (DSPs, job boards, Joveo or similar)
* MBA or equivalent from a recognised institution — useful but never a substitute for the track record above



  





**Build the next chapter of Joveo. Apply now**

0f5af50f.title: Cloud & Infra Services Presales Solution Architect-Bangalore/Noida
0f5af50f.description:
We are looking for an accomplished Cloud \& Infrastructure Services Presales Solution Architect to lead the solutioning for cloud, hybrid infrastructure, data center transformation and managed services opportunities.
 



 This is a hands\-on solutioning role. The architect must be capable of independently developing cloud and data center solutions, architectures, bills of material, resource\-loading models, effort estimates, pricing inputs, transformation roadmaps, operating models and customer proposals.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Presales and Opportunity Solutioning** 



* Lead technical solutioning for Cloud and Infrastructure Services opportunities across RFIs, RFPs, proactive pursuits, renewals, expansions and transformation programs.
* Analyze customer business goals, technical requirements, existing infrastructure landscape, service levels, operations challenges and contractual requirements.
* Develop compelling solution strategies, win themes, transformation hypotheses, value propositions and solution differentiators.
* Own the technical response from initial opportunity qualification through proposal submission, customer presentation and SOW preparation.



**2\. Cloud Transformation Solutioning** 



* Architect solutions across public cloud, private cloud, hybrid cloud and multi\-cloud environments.
* Design cloud landing zones covering account or subscription structure, identity, network connectivity, security, governance, monitoring, logging, backup, disaster recovery and cost management.
* Develop cloud adoption, migration, consolidation and modernization roadmaps.
* Develop migration factories, wave plans, effort models, migration schedules, cutover approaches, testing strategies and hypercare models.
* Use native AWS and Azure pricing tools to create infrastructure configurations, consumption estimates and commercial inputs.



**3\. Data Center and Hybrid Infrastructure Solutioning** 



* Design transformation and managed services solutions for enterprise data center and hybrid infrastructure environments.
* Design data center migration, consolidation, exit and cloud\-adoption solutions.
* Incorporate high availability, DR, backup, security, performance and regulatory requirements into the solution architecture.



**4\. Managed Services Solutioning** 



* Design end\-to\-end managed services solutions for cloud, data center and hybrid infrastructure operations.
* Define service delivery models covering shared, dedicated, offshore, nearshore and onsite constructs.
* Design automation\-led operating models using AIOps, event correlation, orchestration, self\-healing, infrastructure as code and automated remediation.
* Develop productivity and optimization roadmaps with clearly defined and supportable benefits.



**5\. Commercial and Deal Support** 



* Work with finance and commercial teams to develop competitive and financially viable pricing models.
* Build bottom\-up effort estimates for transformation projects and managed services.
* Support deal\-shaping decisions including scope optimization, delivery location, resource mix, automation benefits and risk provisions.
* Identify solution and commercial risks and recommend appropriate mitigations.
* Participate in internal deal reviews, governance checkpoints and approval processes.



  





**Experience Requirements** 



* Minimum
 **15 years of overall experience** 
 in IT infra, cloud and related services.
* Strong experience in
 **Cloud \& Infra Services presales and solution architecture** 
 .
* Demonstrable experience designing both:
* **Transformation solutions** 
 , such as cloud adoption, migrations, modernization, data center exits, consolidation and technology refresh.
* **Managed services solutions** 
 , including operating models, staffing, transition, SLAs, automation and service improvement.
* Strong experience with Azure, AWS, hybrid cloud \& enterprise DC technologies.
* Proven ability to independently build technical solutions, architectures, bills of material, resource\-loading models and pricing inputs.
* Experience working with globally distributed sales, delivery, practice, finance, commercial and partner teams.
* Prior infrastructure implementation or operations experience is desirable



**Educational Qualifications** 



* BE in Comp Science, Information Technology or a related discipline.



**Preferred Certifications** 




 One or more of the following would be desirable:
 


* AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, VMware certification, ITIL certification



**Behavioral Competencies** 



* Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving skills
* Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills
* Strong commercial awareness
* Ability to work independently and take end\-to\-end ownership
* Strong collaboration and stakeholder\-management skills
* Attention to detail with focus on solution quality and commercial protection

**Job Summary**

* Demonstrates product expertise in most Genesys Cloud products
* Provides top quality service engagements for large or strategic customers or other accounts serving as the lead technical advisor and/or engineer
* Follows PS implementation standards
* Assesses complex Genesys Cloud implementations to make appropriate recommendations to both Genesys and the customer
* Initiates and suggests process improvements to Project Managers / Service Delivery Managers and other Management to increase efficiencies for delivery of Genesys Cloud solutions or support


**Major Responsibilities/Activities**
 The Genesys Cloud consultant is responsible for delivering and supporting Genesys Cloud solutions for customers or Partners. This position is responsible for developing a high level of expertise across the majority of Genesys products. The consultant should be flexible to work on post\-production support projects as well.
   

  

**Technical Consultation**

* Follows PS implementation standards
* Delivers post\-GoLive production support activities and customer environment management (Operational Support Management/OSM)
* Execution of project plan tasks associated with engagements
* Test plan validation in close collaboration with Quality Assurance team
* Regular communication of project status
* Provides onsite/remote support for customer escalations as needed
* Maintains on average of 70\+% utilization for billable projects
* Identifies engagement\-related problem areas and solves the issues in a proactive manner
* Assists the Customer Care organization in performing service call/maintenance activities as required
* Provide technical training to internal or external resources as needed
* Maintains friendly and professional attitude in stressful situations
* Collaborate and consult directly with customers as an individual contributor in our Professional Services team.
* Be prepared to operate on one or more projects at a time due to skill demand.
* Flexible to support post\-production (Operations Service Management) type projects
* Own the troubleshooting of production solutions where necessary.
* Operate within both Agile and Waterfall engineering methods.
* Meet expectations of the Professional Services processes such as within\-budget and quality deliverables, time and status reporting, mentoring, best practices, documentation, debriefs and training certification up\-keep.

* Provides feedback and updates to internal process through internal documentation
* Follows standard department processes.

* Continues to stay abreast of new Genesys product releases through internal training, shadowing experienced consultants, lab development, and industry standards training/certifications


**Minimum Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in a Computer Engineering/Computer Science/Computer Technology/Telecommunication or related discipline or equivalent professional technical experience
* 3\+ years of related experience
* Prior experience with Genesys Cloud Implementation and/or Administration is mandatory
* Prior experience working on Genesys Digital Channel customer projects deploying Email, SMS, ChatBot, Social media channels will be a plus.
* Good technical problem\-solving skills and ability to collaborate in troubleshooting challenging configurations.
* Flexibility to work across different time zones specifically North America
* Flexibility to take up a operational service management role (managing a customer environment), if there is business need


**Technical Skills**
* Knowledge of HTTP requests, REST web services, and JSON
* IP Telephony \& Hardware: Genesys Cloud Edge, Audiocodes, Cisco Gateways, IP Telephones (Polycom, Cisco, etc.)
* Cisco/Juniper/other network routing and switching devices is an added advantage.
* Software: Wireshark, MS Server, DHCP/DNS, MS Hyper\-V, VMWare ESXi, MS Visio, MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access), Email (MS Outlook)
* Software Development experience in Java and C\#.NET, Python, PHP, web application development scripting, tools and methods is a BIG Plus
* Operating Systems: Windows 200/2008/2012R2, XP, Vista, Windows 7
* Knowledge on Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a bonus


**Business Skills**
* Capable of working on or leading a team through a fast paced and complex project.
* Excellent verbal and written business communication skills (English is a must), including escalation management and information presentation.

* Knowledge of customer service processes.
* Knowledge of Cloud change control processes.

* Strong follow\-through, ownership \& responsibility on tasks assigned.
* Effective time management and maintains flexibility
* Demonstrate flexibility to adjust working hours to match customer and team interactions

8501322a.title: Solution Architect – (AI Infrastructure & Hybrid Cloud)
8501322a.description:
**About Gruve**
 Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well\-funded early\-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 We are seeking a Solution Architect – (AI Infrastructure \& Hybrid Cloud) to lead the strategic design, architecture, and deployment of large\-scale, enterprise\-grade Red Hat OpenShift and Kubernetes environments. As a technical authority at the L4 level, you will be responsible for defining the blueprint of our cloud\-native infrastructure, ensuring it is secure, scalable, and highly automated.
   

  

 The ideal candidate acts as the bridge between traditional infrastructure and modern DevOps, serving as the lead design authority for global clients. You will collaborate with Network and Firewall Architects to build a unified fabric where containerized workloads, legacy data centers, and hybrid cloud environments coexist seamlessly through advanced automation and Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC).
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Architect and Design Enterprise OpenShift Solutions: Lead the high\-level design (HLD) and low\-level design (LLD) for multi\-tenant Red Hat OpenShift and Kubernetes clusters across on\-prem and hybrid cloud environments.
* Define the technology stack, standards, and blueprints for deploying AI solutions across global, multi\-region public clouds (AWS/Azure/GCP) and diverse on\-premise hardware.
* Oversee the successful end\-to\-end rollout of critical services including AI SOC, OpenShift AI, and AI\-based Cybersecurity Log Optimization.
* Drive Network DevOps Strategy: Define and standardize the automation roadmap using Ansible, Terraform, and Python to achieve "Zero\-Touch" infrastructure provisioning and configuration.
* Lead Customer \& Stakeholder Engagement: Act as the primary technical consultant for global clients, leading design workshops, architecture validation, and executive\-level technical reviews.
* Integrate Advanced AI apps, Networking \& Security: Collaborate with Pre\-sales, AI application developers \& Engineers, Firewall Architects to design secure AI agents \& use cases, container networking (CNI) models, implementing Zero\-Trust security, service mesh (Istio), and micro\-segmentation within OpenShift environment.
* Optimize Hybrid Infrastructure: Oversee the seamless integration of OpenShift with physical networking (Cisco ACI, VXLAN) and virtualized platforms (RHEL\-V, VMware ESXi).
* GPU \& Hardware Orchestration: Design and manage hardware acceleration using the NVIDIA GPU Operator and Node Feature Discovery (NFD). Implement Multi\-Instance GPU (MIG) and time\-slicing to optimize resource utilization across multi\-tenant clusters.
* Establish CI/CD Governance: Architect robust CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) for infrastructure and application delivery, ensuring compliance and security are baked into the workflow.
* Lead Observability \& Reliability: Design comprehensive monitoring and logging architectures using Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK stack to ensure 99\.99% availability of cluster services.
* Mentorship \& Technical Leadership: Guide and mentor L2/L3 engineers, providing expert\-level escalation support and establishing best practices for the DevOps and Network teams.
* Innovation \& R\&D: Evaluate and introduce emerging technologies such as Advanced Cluster Management (ACM), Advanced Cluster Security (ACS), and Cloud\-Native Networking (OVN\-Kubernetes).


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in systems architecture, infrastructure engineering, or network DevOps.
* Expert/Architect\-level proficiency in OpenShift (RHOS), and Kubernetes architecture in large\-scale production environments.
* Experience architecting hybrid\-cloud OpenShift solutions involving AWS (ROSA), Azure (ARO), or Google Cloud.
* Proven track record in Automation \& IaC: Mastery of Ansible, Terraform, and Git\-based workflows to manage complex infrastructures.
* Deep understanding of Linux (RHEL) Internals: Mastery of kernel networking, storage drivers (CSI), and container runtimes (CRI\-O).
* Strong Network Background: In\-depth knowledge of BGP, VXLAN, and EVPN as they apply to connecting containerized workloads to physical data center fabrics.
* Experience in "Architecture as Code": Ability to develop and maintain compliance artifacts, design validation reports, and automated documentation.
* Excellent Leadership Skills: Demonstrated ability to manage high\-stakes customer relationships and lead cross\-functional technical teams


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Certifications: Red Hat Certified Architect (RHCA), Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift (Administration/Development), or CKA/CKS (Certified Kubernetes Administrator/Security), AWS/GCP Certified DevOps Engineer, AWS Certified SysOps Administrator, HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate
* Red Hat Certified OpenShift Administrator, AWS Certified AI Practitioner, Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP)
* Security Focus: Exposure to DevSecOps tools (e.g., Quay, StackRox) and zero\-trust framework implementation
* Legacy Integration: Familiarity with Cisco ACI, Arista CloudVision, or Juniper Apstra for end\-to\-end automation integration
* Red Hat OpenShift AI (ROAI) expertise will be preferred
* Familiarity with LLM deployment requirements and vector database infrastructure
* Background in Cybersecurity infrastructure (SIEM, SOAR, SOC \& VAPT platforms)
* Experience with MLOps infrastructure (Kubeflow, MLflow) and high\-speed telemetry pipelines


**Why Gruve**
 At Gruve, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute their best work. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

 Gruve is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and thank all who apply; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

5353627b.title: Snowflake Solution Architect
5353627b.description:
Cittabase helps organizations modernize their data platforms and unlock value from enterprise data through cloud\-native architecture, analytics engineering, and applied AI. We're growing our Snowflake practice and looking for a Solution Architect who can design and deliver production\-grade data platforms while also pushing our clients toward Snowflake's newest AI and agentic capabilities.
 



  





 Role
 



  





 We're looking for a Senior Snowflake Solution Architect to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of Snowflake\-based data platforms for our clients. This role combines classic data architecture and analytics engineering (dbt\-driven transformation pipelines) with hands\-on expertise in Snowflake's AI stack — Cortex (Analyst, Search, Agents) and Snowflake CoWork — to help clients move from raw data to governed, conversational, and agentic analytics experiences.
 



  





 You'll work directly with client stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable architectures, mentor engineering teams, and act as the technical authority on all things Snowflake across pre\-sales, delivery, and post\-implementation support.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




  




* Architect end\-to\-end Snowflake data platforms, including ingestion, storage, transformation, security, and consumption layers, aligned to client business requirements and cost/performance goals.
* Design and govern dbt\-based transformation pipelines (models, tests, macros, documentation, CI/CD) that serve as the semantic and quality backbone of the platform.

f5b44eee.title: Senior Oracle Cloud SCM Techno-Functional Architect
f5b44eee.description:
**About The Role**
 We are hiring a hands\-on Senior Oracle Cloud SCM Techno\-Functional Architect, based in our Noida or Bangalore office, to sit at the intersection of our product team and our customers. You will help expand the SCM capabilities of Config Agent and Testing Agent, the automation engines our customers rely on for Oracle configuration migration and test execution, and based on need, support delivery for customers running these products on live Oracle SCM programs.
   

  

 This is not a classic implementation consulting role. You will bring deep Oracle SCM functional and technical knowledge into product development: defining how our agents should handle SCM setups, FBDI conversions, extracts, APIs, and integration touchpoints, validating product behavior against real Oracle environments, and stepping into customer engagements where deep SCM expertise is needed to unblock delivery.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

* Product capability expansion: Partner with product and engineering to design and expand Config Agent and Testing Agent capabilities across Oracle Cloud SCM, including functional setup migration via FSM, FBDI/LOADERS, and setup APIs.
* Architecture ownership: Define the technical architecture for how Opkey agents discover, extract, transform, and load Oracle SCM configuration and transactional data, and how they validate results post\-load.
* Conversions and transformations: Bring authoritative expertise on SCM data conversion and transformation strategy: source\-to\-target mapping, transformation logic, load sequencing, error handling, and reconciliation.
* SCM functional depth: Define how core Oracle SCM modules (Inventory, Procurement, Order Management, and Costing) are configured end to end, so agent automation reflects real setup dependencies, sequencing, and how Oracle actually behaves in customer environments.
* Integrations: Advise on integration patterns across OIC, REST/SOAP web services, and ESS scheduling, and how Opkey automation should exercise and validate them.
* RICEF architecture: Apply full RICEF (Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Extensions, Forms/Workflows) build and architecture experience to shape agent coverage, test design, and configuration scope decisions.
* Customer delivery support: Support Config Agent and Testing Agent customers during SCM implementations and quarterly Oracle releases, troubleshooting complex Oracle\-side issues, validating agent behavior, and advising customer and SI partner technical teams.
* Release advisory: Contribute to functional and technical advisory content on Oracle release cycles (26A to 26D and beyond), migration paths, and platform changes that affect customers and product roadmap.


 What you bring
   

  

* 10\+ years of hands\-on Oracle Cloud SCM implementation experience as a techno\-functional consultant, acting in a lead or architect capacity.
* Deep, practitioner\-level expertise in FBDI/LOADERS: business object structures, load orchestration, error resolution, and large\-volume conversion strategy.
* Deep understanding of backend tables, metadata, and how to query with SQL.
* Proven delivery of data conversions and transformations from legacy systems (EBS, PeopleSoft, SAP, Workday, or homegrown) into Oracle Cloud SCM.
* Functional depth across core SCM modules (Inventory, Procurement, Order Management, and Costing), with proven ownership of FSM setups, organization structures, and cross\-module dependencies.
* Integration build experience across OIC, REST/SOAP APIs, FBDI, and ESS jobs.
* Full\-lifecycle RICEF build and architecture experience: you have designed, built, tested, and supported these objects in production.
* Redwood / Visual Builder Studio familiarity and awareness of Oracle's UI extensibility direction.
* AI Agent Studio experience
* Working knowledge of Oracle configuration frameworks: FSM, security and roles, flexfields, lookups, value sets, and profile options.
* Ability to translate Oracle platform behavior into product requirements: you can explain to engineers why Oracle works the way it does and what automation must account for.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity: this role spans product development, technical advisory, and live customer delivery.
* Clear written and verbal communication for executive, partner, and customer audiences.


 Nice to have
   

  

* Exposure to test automation platforms or ERP testing practices.
* Experience with agentic AI, LLM\-based tooling, or automation frameworks (Playwright, RPA).
* Experience with Manufacturing, Supply Planning, Logistics, or Maintenance modules.
* Big four consulting experience.


 Why this role
   

  

 You will shape how an entire category of Oracle SCM automation works, not for one customer but for every customer running Opkey. Your Oracle expertise becomes product capability with compounding reach, and you keep direct customer contact so your knowledge stays sharp and current with each Oracle release.
   

  

 Opkey is an equal opportunity employer. To apply, contact the Opkey talent team with your CV and a summary of relevant Oracle Cloud SCM delivery experience.
   

  

 Skills: cloud scm,,scm,fbdi,,loaders,,fsm,,supply chain management,oracle scm,ricef,

**Position Title:** 
*Principal\- Cloud \& Infra* 




  





**Location:** 
 India (Chennai and Bangalore preferred)
 



  





**Job Description:** 
 Digitide is looking for a Service Line Owner to lead Cloud \& Infrastructure service line globally. This is a senior role responsible for growing the Cloud \& Infra business through large managed services deals, deepening strategic hyperscaler partnerships (AWS, Microsoft, Google), and driving cloud architecture/modernization, cybersecurity, and AI\-led Master Systems Integration (MSI) as core pillars of the portfolio.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the global Cloud \& Infra service line across Workplace/End\-User Computing, Network, and Data Center/Cloud services.
* Lead the shaping, negotiation, and closure of large and managed services deals (multi\-year, multi\-million\-dollar TCV) spanning infrastructure outsourcing, cloud managed services, and workplace/network operations.
* Own and grow strategic hyperscaler relationships with AWS, Microsoft (Azure), and Google Cloud — co\-sell motions, joint solutioning, partner funding/incentive programs, and specialization/competency certifications.
* Define and drive the cloud architecture and modernization roadmap — legacy\-to\-cloud migration factories, application modernization, FinOps, and cloud\-native reference architectures for enterprise clients.
* Embed cybersecurity into the infra portfolio — oversee security\-by\-design architecture, and build/scale managed security offerings.
* Champion Digitide's AI\-led Master Systems Integrator (MSI) positioning — orchestrating multi\-vendor technology stacks (cloud, security, automation, AI/LLM tooling) into unified client outcomes.
* Represent Cloud \& Infra in CEO/CXO\-level client and analyst conversations across US and India geographies, and act as the executive escalation point for large managed services accounts.
* Partner with Presales, Alliances, and Analyst/Advisor Relations to shape competitive, differentiated infra offerings, solutions and bids
* Strengthen Digitide's positioning in analyst rankings.



  





**Qualifications:** 



* 15\-20 years of progressive experience in IT Infrastructure, Cloud, and Cybersecurity services, including senior service\-line ownership roles
* Demonstrated experience working across US and India markets — managing distributed teams and US/India\-based client relationships.
* Proven track record leading and closing large/managed services deals (typically $10M\-$25M TCV) spanning infrastructure outsourcing or cloud managed services.
* Deep experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud at the partnership/alliance level (co\-sell, funding programs, joint GTM).
* Strong grounding in cloud architecture and modernization — migration methodologies, cloud\-native design, and FinOps/cost optimization at enterprise scale.
* Working knowledge of cybersecurity domains relevant to infrastructure (network security, cloud security posture management, Zero Trust, managed SOC/VAPT services).
* Exposure to AI\-led infrastructure operations or Master Systems Integrator (MSI) delivery models is strongly preferred.



  





  





**Why Join Us?** 




  





 This role puts you at the executive table, representing Cloud \& Infra directly to CEOs, CXOs, and analysts across US and India — with a real seat in shaping enterprise deals and strategic direction, not just executing on them. You'll build without bureaucracy, in a culture that prizes speed, agility, and entrepreneurial spirit, giving you the empowerment and flexibility to build the service line your way, backed by 55,000 associates and a 20\+ year global track record. And you'll grow at scale, joining an organization with a presence across 40 locations in 5 countries, offering the platform, resources, and runway to build something significant and be recognized for it. It's a rare opportunity to combine strategic ownership with the backing of a large, established global platform — and to leave your mark on how Digitide defines the future of Cloud \& Infra.

Title: Consulting Systems Engineer
 



 Location: Mumbai (Hybrid)
 



 Experience: 10\+ years
 



  





**Why WWT?** 




 World Wide Technology (WWT) strives to make a new world happen. WWT's work benefits clients and partners as much as it does its people and community across the globe.
 



 Founded in 1990, WWT brings together strategy, deep technical expertise and world\-class partnerships to help public and private sector organizations design, build and scale intelligent AI, digital, cybersecurity, cloud and infrastructure solutions. Through its Advanced Technology Center (ATC)—a collaborative ecosystem featuring state\-of\-the\-art hardware and software—WWT enables clients and partners to conceptualize, test and validate innovative technology and then deploy solutions at scale using its global integration and distribution capabilities.
 



  





 With more than 14,000 team members and over 60 locations globally, WWT's culture—grounded in core values and leadership philosophies—has been recognized by Fortune® and Great Place to Work for its commitment to innovation, trust and creating a great place to work for all. WWT provides products and services to large enterprise, global service provider and public sector clients in up to 130 countries across six continents. Softchoice, a World Wide Technology company, supports commercial and SMB markets in the U.S. and Canada.
 



 Want to work with highly motivated individuals on high\-performance teams? Join WWT today!
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* Act as Technical Pre\-Sales and systems engineering supporting Modern DC Infrastructure Solutions including all combination’s across (Enterprise Storage SAN/NAS/Object, Enterprise Compute, Converged and Hyperconverged, Virtualization, K8, Backup / Recovery, Networking, DC Build including Racks, power, cooling infra).
* Conduct market research to identify selling possibilities and evaluate customer needs and use cases aligned to WWT GTM.
* Serve as the trusted technical advisor to assigned clients and market segments and align your efforts and activities to identify pain points and proactively create unsolicited solution proposals and/or respond to RFP / RFI as needed.
* Work with clients and WWT Sales team to establish clear understanding to customers’ technical priorities, challenges, and initiatives that can be translated into business opportunities.
* Responsible for presales solution deliverables which may include aligning WWT portfolio of capabilities and SME as needed, to develop proposals, architectural solutions, diagram and presentation decks, that are aligned to meet customer requirements.
* Create Level of Effort Documents that accurately capture customers solution and service requirements, participate in proof of concepts (POC/POV), create and validate Solution Bill of Materials, take technical ownership on the final Statements of Work to the customer.
* Develops and fosters relationships with strategic original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and partners (internal as well as external) in country / region and/or territory.
* Leverage OEM process and tools to maximize deal profitability create an optimized BOQ, perform BOM validations in line with solution requirement, able to work with OEM / partners to demonstrate and defend the proposed solutions (objection handling).
* Ensures that proposed solutions, when implemented, meet the needs and functional requirements of the customer.



  





**Qualifications:** 



* 10\+ years of Enterprise DC Environment and min 5\+ years of Pre\-Sales (technical sales / Sales engineering), experience (preferably with a System Integrator company).
* Mandatory exposure to maximum combination of OEMs across DC Infra OEMS including (Rack, Storage and Compute, OS Virtualization, Containers, Storage Networking, Disaster Recovery including backups, HPC Networking, Cloud, AIOPS)
* Strong business, commercial and technical understanding of DC Infra products and solution stack sizing, best practice architecture(s) along with industry specific use case positioning.
* This position requires an in depth understanding of DC Infra components a thorough understanding of DC solution stack from infra traversing through middleware, operating systems, containers, storage and compute including various modern DC Infra architectures.
* Knowledge of selling solutions and experience in large Enterprise environments, HPC Infra environments in tandem with Hybrid cloud environments will is a must for this role.
* Experience in using OEM BOM / BOQ configuration tool to create various solutions/ BOM / BOQ.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills, able to create contents, deliver effective presentations, competitive objection handling, run and manage POC / solution demo. Exposure and confidence in delivering presentations in one to one as well as one to many settings is mandatory.
* Market awareness of latest and greatest developments in market pertaining to IT Infra market.



  





 The well\-being of WWT employees is essential. So, when it comes to our benefits package, WWT has one of the best. We offer the following benefits to all full\-time employees:
 


* Health and Wellbeing: Heath, Dental, and Vision Care, Onsite Health Centers, Employee Assistance Program, Wellness program
* Financial Benefits: Competitive pay, Profit Sharing, PF Plan with Company Matching, NPS (National Pension Scheme), Life and Disability Insurance, Tuition Reimbursement
* Paid Time Off: PTO \& Holidays, Parental Leave, Sick Leave, Day of Caring for social responsibility, Bereavement



  





 Note: This is not an all\-encompassing list and should not be used as a complete description of the plan’s benefits.
 



 We strive to create an environment where all employees are empowered to succeed based on their skills, performance, and dedication. Our goal is to cultivate a culture of belonging that encourages innovation, collaboration, and respect for all team members, ensuring that WWT remains a great place to work for All!
